Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has _promised_ that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

Derek,
Building a grassroots campaign for U.S. Senate in the country’s most populous state doesn’t happen overnight. So today, I want to pull back the curtain a bit.
Unlike many other states, California has an all-parties jungle primary. That means that _not only_ will most of our state’s 22 million voters be seeing my name on the ballot for statewide office for the very first time — they’ll be seeing it alongside **Republicans, Independents, and other Democrats**. More than _two dozen candidates_ in total.
California’s next U.S. Senator will be expected to take on the big fights and get things done. To protect our democracy. Protect our climate. And create an economy that works for everyone. **That’s why Republicans are making me Public Enemy #1. They’ve seen how effective I can be. And they’re willing to go to any lengths to keep me out of the Senate.**
**[I don’t take corporate PAC contributions, Derek — I’m relying on _your_ support to win this U.S. Senate election. So I wanted to ask: Will you start making a monthly donation of $5.80 to help us win all 58 California counties in the primary election on March 5? ](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2968?c0=oct2023_abs_em_recurring.4UEcvs&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20231019_PM2_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=4251%2E5257348%2E5zu_1u)**

Then a far-right lawmaker introduced a resolution to censure me and fine me $16 million as punishment for investigating Trump’s abuses of office — and Trump issued personal threats to get every last House Republican to censure me. And they haven’t stopped attacking me since (_Really, Trump went after me again just LAST week on a conservative radio program_).
Trump and the MAGA movement are using every dirty trick in the book to defeat me. And Fox News is helping them do it. **We need to reach every voter possible to share the truth about our campaign and ensure every voter knows about the work I’m doing to protect our democracy.**

The failure of House Republicans to unite behind any proposed candidate for Speaker of the House is equal parts ridiculous, revealing, ironic, and opportune. Many reasons suggest that their intrapartisan gridlock is poorly timed, internationally embarrassing, and institutionally devastating.
But it may ultimately be a good thing for the world.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5db19a88-b832-492b-aa8d-95f789241d7d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
While the rest of the world is glued to a conflict [enabled by weapons from Washington](https://substack.com/redirect/3c859f35-e8a5-4d33-914d-ee904431c3dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the peoples' representatives in the capital are so fragmented that they can't even agree on who can represent and lead them--let alone any coherent policy framework to address any of the various mounting crises they have publicly proven themselves incapable of addressing.
### **Chaos in Congress ...**
Many observers have proclaimed a crisis driven by the House of Representatives appearing [unable](https://substack.com/redirect/d4412cfa-fdbc-4739-8e04-f16e2e4a9e0d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to elect a Speaker, and thus remaining paralyzed while the war on Gaza continues to escalate.
In the age of disinformation, the fog of war grows even thicker. Help your friends see through it by sharing this post with them.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1018597&post_id=138119914&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTM4MTE5OTE0LCJpYXQiOjE2OTc3NjQ3NDcsImV4cCI6MTcwMDM1Njc0NywiaXNzIjoicHViLTEwMTg1OTciLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.aHW80x5HYMSfN5OiY_aOL7TEnck6-wZCWf3VtHgkQOs)
In fact, when government grows [unaccountably](https://substack.com/redirect/775b2859-9409-4448-9619-afbc8e0bf11d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) committed to ecocide and genocide, institutional dysfunction might be a good thing. The logjam in Congress should embarrass Washington before the international community, but it could at least keep yet more weapons from flowing into either Ukraine, Palestine, or any of the crisis regions around the world from which Wall Street [extracts massive profit from violence](https://substack.com/redirect/775b2859-9409-4448-9619-afbc8e0bf11d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
One concern presented by such dysfunction paralyzing Congress at this particular time is how it demonstrates to the world that our country's system of governance is not nearly as resilient, dynamic, or responsive as proponents of [Pax Americana](https://substack.com/redirect/823bee93-6209-450e-a61a-ced3ed5039b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) have always proclaimed.
While the rest of the world is glued to a conflict [enabled by weapons from Washington](https://substack.com/redirect/3c859f35-e8a5-4d33-914d-ee904431c3dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the peoples' representatives in the capital are so fragmented that they can't even agree on who can represent and lead them--let alone any coherent policy framework to address any of the various mounting crises they have publicly proven themselves incapable of addressing.
That, also, is a good thing. The world has been fed enough lies from Washington already.
Any demonstration of Washington's institutional ineptitude can only help encourage the further exposure of its deep-seated corruption. That, in turn, could help prevent yet another war from erupting anywhere from the south China Sea to Iran.
Over 22,000 readers receive this newsletter. Under 100 support it. To receive new posts and support my work, consider joining them, whether with a free or a paid subscription.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..BD0M--LWj9i7HOZh8RSH3A-z-pahvSfGlJGF6W-dWeY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=138119914)
On one hand, the House lacking a Speaker also hamstrings Congress from dealing with pressing problems from the climate catastrophe to the housing crisis. But policymakers have been doing relatively little to address most of those fronts, anyway, so this month's melodrama might simply expose more broadly what close observers have long recognized.
Does dysfunction threaten worthwhile social spending programs, like support for needy families, environmental testing, and food and product safety programs?
As long as previously appropriated funds remain available for those programs, the recent dysfunction in the House will not threaten them. It will relatively uniquely hamstring legislation that would otherwise be at the front of the congressional agenda this fall, such as further appropriations for weapons, whether for Israel or Ukraine.
On the other hand, the House [flirted](https://substack.com/redirect/2446c60f-a91b-4bf8-8d43-0624988ef414?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with a government shutdown just a few weeks ago. Another one may become effectively inevitable if policy makers can't figure out soon who in the chamber is best poised to represent them. And any time the government shuts down, it places those important programs either in suspension or at existential risk altogether.
### **... could offer opportunity**
Ironically, even though Republicans outnumber Democrats, the vast distinctions among the perspectives within that caucus prevent anyone from within it to ascending to the Speakership. Ultimately, the most likely Speaker of the House in the current Congress is Hakeem Jeffries, the leader of the minority party.
Just to be clear, I would rather see progressives in the House [mount a strategy similar](https://substack.com/redirect/9349e1e6-1506-4689-a31e-301f065101f7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to those taken by right wing Republicans to deny the speakership to centrist leaders and force their policy issues onto the table.
If Jeffries is to be the Speaker, progressives should at least finally demand a transparent vote on the floor on the universal healthcare proposal [favored](https://substack.com/redirect/ed682c03-61a1-4f01-bc7b-b8a4f3868681?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by bipartisan majorities of Americans and [already](https://substack.com/redirect/0381d958-52d2-4588-b0fd-92504b0a8ba6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in place (in one form or another) around the rest of the world.
The [medical debt crisis](https://substack.com/redirect/d106c95f-9e00-48e2-bafa-42494afce895?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that has already swept the country is a financial chokehold on multiple generations. It's one reason why birth rates are [dropping](https://substack.com/redirect/fcaefd6c-7064-4f8e-9f9c-9beba93da7fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) precipitously, which should be recognized as a national security crisis to the extent that conservatives want also to shut down our nation's borders.
Doctors are warning that [the Covid pandemic could surge again](https://substack.com/redirect/ddabfc17-28b8-4c8f-8d89-8508e9c18c76?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) this winter. If that happens, the crisis in medical debt may be poised to grow even worse.
This week's charade in Washington offers both drama and amusement. It also offers a crucial opportunity to advance public health and human rights, if progressives in the House discover their influence and see fit to use it.

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: everyone's betting on this...
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

Media elites, pollsters, and political “experts” all want to know . . .

**–** _Does the Abortion Lobby have the momentum heading into 2024?_

**–** _Or, are enough Americans – even in a “purple” state like Virginia – souring on President Biden that his re-election hopes are doomed?_
That’s why, as one of the few states that has off-year elections this year, Virginia will be one of **THE** biggest tests to see who will have the momentum going into 2024 – either pro-lifers or the Abortion Lobby?

With time running out until Election Day – and early voting well underway – this is crunch time, Pro-Life Friend.

And we’re counting on your financial support to finish **_STRONG_!**

**[So, can I count on you to make your most generous contribution possible to help fund _Students for Life Action’s_ critical Virginia Election Programs today](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sgodk-duchtdja-y/)?**

Your support could help us send jaws dropping across the country.

After all, Virginia is a state President Biden won by 10%.

But in 2021, Republicans took control of the Governor’s Mansion and the House of Delegates.

_Should pro-lifers take the State Senate in 2023, it could pave the way for major pro-life reforms – and send shivers down the spines of pro-abortion politicians nationwide_!

Especially because Virginia Democrats have effectively chosen abortion as their one-and-only campaign issue.

Thanks to your support, _Students for Life Action_ has been hard at work on the ground in the Old Dominion.

Our student leaders have hosted several canvassing trips around Virginia the past few months and have a few more to go.
[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sgodk-duchtdja-j/)
But the rising costs of travel and activism materials – _especially on a shoestring budget like mine_ – it’s really stretching our budgets!

In fact, we need $16,000 to fund our final two canvassing trips.

**[That’s why I’m counting on your generous financial support today](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sgodk-duchtdja-i/).**

Frankly, with time running out, we have to put the pedal to the metal.

There’s not a moment to waste!

The great news is, all of the work our students do – thanks to the generosity of you Pro-Life Friend – is what’s going to put the pro-life movement ahead.

_Thousands of pre-born babies are counting on us for their chance at Life._

**[So, can I please count on you to make your most prayerful donation to _Students for Life Action_ right away so we can stick it to these pro-abortion VA politicians](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sgodk-duchtdja-d/)?**

Our involvement will also have a national impact by building a narrative that life is winning.

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, Students for Life Action

Throughout pivotal moments in history, we have witnessed the remarkable transformation of seemingly lost causes, orchestrated by the savior generals--visionary leaders displaying unparalleled expertise.

Today, I'm pleased to share with you a free resource that will ignite your curiosity and challenge your perceptions. Esteemed historian and Hoover Senior Fellow, **Victor Davis Hanson** , has authored a groundbreaking eBook--_Victory and the Savior Generals_ --a captivating exploration into the minds of these exceptional leaders.

You can secure your free copy today by clicking on this exclusive link: **[https://resources.hoover.org/victory-and-the-savior-generals](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zb8826ce2j5boqldubsc67j0c8jod5ef1e89ogv8_rp22sh2s8i66p77ctie6o33cjh2bs)**

Inside its digital pages, you'll embark on a journey that uncovers the defining traits of these savior generals. Their ingenuity, contrarian spirit, and unwavering courage breathed new life into seemingly lost causes. Their profound understanding of conflict, rejection of complacency, adaptability to change, and alignment with societal values contributed to their monumental successes.

This is your opportunity to unravel the secrets of history's most influential leaders, unlocking invaluable lessons that resonate even in the present day.

Claim your complimentary copy of _Victory and the Savior Generals_ now through this secure link: **[https://resources.hoover.org/victory-and-the-savior-generals](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z6avi13d4km7in1m4udpt0ate44po93lca4m4vn0_rp22sh2s8i66p77ctie6o33cjh2bs)**

Wishing you a wonderful journey through the pages of history!

Greg

Greg Stamps | Online Development
Hoover Institution | Stanford University

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

body:
I'm pleased to share with you a free resource that will ignite your curiosity and challenge your perceptions.

| | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c24340%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=pI%2ffhW2L6FN4fjassBzlLA&sysid=1)

| | Dear Friend, [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c24341%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=CH7zIMtlJQz7uJn3yOiH3A&sysid=1)
Throughout pivotal moments in history, we have witnessed the remarkable transformation of seemingly lost causes, orchestrated by the savior generals--visionary leaders displaying unparalleled expertise.

Today, I'm pleased to share with you a free resource that will ignite your curiosity and challenge your perceptions. Esteemed historian and Hoover Senior Fellow, **Victor Davis Hanson** , has authored a groundbreaking eBook--_Victory and the Savior Generals_ --a captivating exploration into the minds of these exceptional leaders.

You can secure your free copy today by clicking on this exclusive link: **[https://resources.hoover.org/victory-and-the-savior-generals](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c24342%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=AjcrdLXI98W%2bEE%2b2gzinBg&sysid=1)**

Inside its digital pages, you'll embark on a journey that uncovers the defining traits of these savior generals. Their ingenuity, contrarian spirit, and unwavering courage breathed new life into seemingly lost causes. Their profound understanding of conflict, rejection of complacency, adaptability to change, and alignment with societal values contributed to their monumental successes.

This is your opportunity to unravel the secrets of history's most influential leaders, unlocking invaluable lessons that resonate even in the present day.

Claim your complimentary copy of _Victory and the Savior Generals_ now through this secure link: **[https://resources.hoover.org/victory-and-the-savior-generals](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c24342%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=AjcrdLXI98W%2bEE%2b2gzinBg&sysid=1)**

Wishing you a wonderful journey through the pages of history!

Greg

body:
America is on the brink of destruction.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? subject: This isn't over ... yet
body:

|

| Fellow Patriot,

This is Dr. Ben Carson--I'm writing to you personally because your name is on my list of Americans who cherish life and want to protect the unborn. **And today I need your help.**

I know you're as grateful as I am for the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe. But I'm also concerned that the pro-life movement will mistakenly think this ruling means the fight is won. [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z44mifk3c9m8vuni2bi0t9elh1p8iv3fm0t4dac8_rp22sh2s8i66p77c3g6coj1chh2bs) **Nothing could be further from the truth --**

Right now, the Left is working around the clock to undermine the Supreme Court's decision while mobilizing millions of pro-choice democrats and major media outlets to codify abortion-on-demand at the expense of taxpayers like you.

**We cannot allow the anti-life movement to obscure the fact that a majority of Americans (regardless of how they vote) do NOT agree that abortion should be unrestricted.**

We must stand together to defend a culture of life across America. If we don't act now, I'm afraid that radicalized idealogues will continue to seize positions of power and abuse their authority to advance an anti-life agenda that is bent on the destruction of the American family.

**Today, I 'd like to invite you to join thousands of others who believe the sanctity of life is worth defending by adding your name to the pledge I have linked below:**

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/pro-life-statement/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z1lng8ntslreoj5vdl14n9d9o3rruoo2f9smh8b0_rp22sh2s8i66p77c3g6coj1chh2bs)

I will do everything in my power to defend every American life and stop the spread of the Left's anti-life ideology.
[**Will you take a minute to stand with me by signing this pledge now?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ze9iv7d31ib3agjkevb7d67tamb1f1jua40a4130_rp22sh2s8i66p77c3g6coj1chh2bs)

I'd like to thank you for joining this critical effort. Together, we can save thousands of lives from abortion over the next year.

Gratefully,
Dr. Ben Carson

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: This isn't over ... yet
body:
This is Dr. Ben Carson—I’m writing to you personally because your name is on my list of Americans who cherish life and want to protect the unborn.

|
---
| | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zdsihcb5o38ja9tt0oluhbf1k2f0barh1m4pge6o_rp22sh2s8i66p77c3g66o72c1h2bs)
---
| Fellow Patriot,

This is Dr. Ben Carson--I'm writing to you personally because your name is on my list of Americans who cherish life and want to protect the unborn. **And today I need your help.**

I know you're as grateful as I am for the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe. But I'm also concerned that the pro-life movement will mistakenly think this ruling means the fight is won. [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z0ft6qvitsdup218gv0n9ftp69uukl79nh8s9sq0_rp22sh2s8i66p77c3g66o72c1h2bs) **Nothing could be further from the truth --**
[the fight for life is only just beginning!](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zmii9obcrf8ob6ce47nu4bho7glu1ed4j4j3dl0o_rp22sh2s8i66p77c3g66o72c1h2bs)

Right now, the Left is working around the clock to undermine the Supreme Court's decision while mobilizing millions of pro-choice democrats and major media outlets to codify abortion-on-demand at the expense of taxpayers like you.

**We cannot allow the anti-life movement to obscure the fact that a majority of Americans (regardless of how they vote) do NOT agree that abortion should be unrestricted.**

We must stand together to defend a culture of life across America. If we don't act now, I'm afraid that radicalized idealogues will continue to seize positions of power and abuse their authority to advance an anti-life agenda that is bent on the destruction of the American family.

**Today, I 'd like to invite you to join thousands of others who believe the sanctity of life is worth defending by adding your name to the pledge I have linked below:**

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/pro-life-statement/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zmbrv8509dn9qqklhghm48a6ldoof2bd10040gl8_rp22sh2s8i66p77c3g66o72c1h2bs)

By signing the pledge, you will join a thriving movement of principled citizens who are uniting to protect the unborn and refusing to be silenced by a vocal minority of radicalized fanatics.

I will do everything in my power to defend every American life and stop the spread of the Left's anti-life ideology.
[**Will you take a minute to stand with me by signing this pledge now?**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zo5cgftsi24hjc5e6ve6eslsdr6bgcmr8jink468_rp22sh2s8i66p77c3g66o72c1h2bs)

I'd like to thank you for joining this critical effort. Together, we can save thousands of lives from abortion over the next year.

Gratefully,
Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

## $7 a Share for Mickey Mantle's Old House
Baseball fans and investors can soon own [a share of Mickey Mantle's childhood home](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOozAQQL_GdIPGAyakoLiGLtdeiSZ4iH0xDMLeoPz9Kltv-aRXPL1_t-nGMcXt8ZdXGcqiE88lvmSyCIRAzdRWflhESJpKBttdLz12nXNVGDxbhyI9I7u7Ze8Xmr1Ftlfbzy21VRwIqbFIiFfnHNVLR0i2t96hd9i1pkXxsehR_9e4lSBLeutLjnrWtUpDKGXPpvljaDQ0nudZz_ecdz1K_hiGxjXdDY2bnPkDcX7KG1beSpIMc4jJB1UPQVeBuIE-EwddGYrCQ-Frh0UPyJwEuIBu6Q0XYMiBDzE0Vsfg9zOmFHN3MS0-Vo7pJ638fuo7AAD__whma3g) in Commerce, Oklahoma, for only $7. body:
I wish I were writing to you under happier circumstances...

Dear Friend,
I wish I were writing to you under happier circumstances...
...but my hero police officer husband, Mark Wagner, is the next big target of the radical anti-police movement and I urgently need your help before they make an example out of him.
That's Mark in the picture I sent you, along with our boys Nolan and Jacob and dog Kilo.
[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8e55f19c92364d608a7d5770e66bb7eb&_e=ExvEv00Vdb8kkcMI2IWyAfiB2E1K-qmxV8KoO7EiqA9j1tzqEu8zxiJ4axkkadeQz-fHvGlYcM0Ji-8wnh5DGx3LPmzrttutPOZLS64zMFW5MBz531PSTJXXmwqqqaPy-OhGX6CAlm5SJI6KCiti05LjbHvwSBqnfUm6Ib81tiYwFWxzIhSmt-RBB05dH3i8wzmM7ljU0WaFtub9UR_WhpMU_fCWcIG7R-9iGcBlPNARqS9rXD6Y18CZHcaLUxpuR3SGLlMXq0GS8tgF8VPRClv7LTcN-ywZqN196i1m_aZEdRgCTQj9FL5VKttIouChLW0HER0TSAQWZlgMoK3PGrI9xpqM_x5Oh6KRDBJUuo8%3D)
Not only is Mark a highly respected officer, he's an incredibly supportive father, a loving husband, and a fierce friend.
He's dedicated his life to protecting others. But we live in far-Left Madison, Wisconsin - and the "defund the police" mob whipped up rage, LIED about what happened, and trashed Mark's reputation.
And now Mark faces 10 YEARS behind bars for doing exactly what he was trained to do in the line of duty - and I'm scared I might lose him. Mark's arrest team planned to capture Wilson in his vehicle using a containment strategy. They pulled in their trucks to block his car on both ends. But Wilson floored the accelerator, spinning his wheels wildly in a desperate attempt to escape justice.
Mark and another officer exited their vehicle to make the arrest. Mark was holding one of those big POLICE shields and had his gun drawn. But Wilson refused Mark's commands to show his hands, continuing to spin his wheels and try to force his way out.
With the wheels screeching and smoking, Mark and the other officer saw Wilson reach into the center console and pull his hand up.
Mark thought Wilson had a gun. He heard what he thought was gunfire. Then Mark felt something hit the shield he was holding and push him backward.** **
**Both Mark and the other officer responded to this life-threatening situation by firing into the vehicle.**
Mark believed his life and his fellow officers' lives were in danger. He did what he was trained to do and stopped the threat.
Thankfully, Wilson survived and no one else was injured. But because Wilson is black and Mark is white - anti-police radicals jumped at the chance to target Mark.
Protesters drummed up a racial firestorm by spreading lies that Wilson "had his hands up" and that he "was shot five times in the back." The corrupt liberal media repeated these lies and painted my husband as a monster.

---|---|---

| | **BREAKING NEWS: Kroger receives a D- score for failing to protect bees! Tell Kroger to stop selling food grown with BEE-KILLING pesticides! >> **_[**Take action now!**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2062297?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)_ Over the last two decades, populations of critical wild bee species have plummeted – **some by more than 90%**! **1 in every 3 bites of food we eat is thanks to pollinators,** meaning our food system is tied to their fate – including the food that Kroger sells. But Kroger, the largest traditional supermarket in the nation, continues to sell food grown with toxic pesticides that can **KILL BEES!** That’s why it scored a dismal D- on Friends of the Earth’s 2023 Bee-Friendly Retailer Scorecard that was just published. Every moment Kroger fails to act, more bees are harmed – that’s why we need your help RIGHT NOW, Friend! [_**Will you help PROTECT BEES from toxic pesticides? Send your message to Kroger now!**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2062298?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) ***219 Signatures Missing from your area*** | [SIGN THE PETITION NOW ](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2062299?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
One class of pesticides, which we’ve found in some of Kroger and other retailers’ produce, has made U.S. agriculture nearly _**50 TIMES more toxic to bees in the past three decades.**_ These deadly pesticides are called neonics, and they’ve also been linked to serious health issues in people. And they can’t be washed off of our food – **every part of the plant absorbs the neonic pesticides.**
Meanwhile, Kroger is falling behind its competitors. Retailers like Giant Eagle, Walmart, and Whole Foods – while far from perfect – have taken action to help protect bees.
**Friend, now is a crucial moment for you to send a message to Kroger.** Our Bee-Friendly Retailer Scorecard has just been released, and we need to keep the pressure up. If just 1 of every 7 people reading this email takes action, we can help protect pollinators from toxic pesticides. [_**Please, Friend, send your message to Kroger urging the company to STOP selling food grown with bee-killing pesticides!**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2062300?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

Lisa Archer

Nearly half of crime goes unreported in San Francisco, a poll published on Wednesday by local political research group GrowSF found. The survey, which received 458 responses, found that although nearly a quarter of San Francisco residents have been the victim of a crime, 47% chose not to report the incident to the police, according to GrowSF.

name: Rashida Tlaib via Justice Democrats
subject: Ceasefire Now:
body:
We need legislation that saves as many lives as possible, no matter one’s faith or ethnicity.
#
Peter,
Over this past week, tens of thousands of people have rallied in cities across the U.S. for a ceasefire. Hundreds of Jewish Americans have been arrested while protesting to end the Israeli military’s unfolding genocide against Palestinians, and thousands blocked entrances to the White House on Monday calling for a ceasefire.
In Congress, I just joined 12 other Democrats to introduce the _Ceasefire Now Resolution_ , urging the Biden administration to call for an immediate de-escalation and ceasefire in Israel and occupied Palestine, and to send humanitarian aid and assistance to people under siege and trapped in Gaza.
**The collective punishment of Palestinian civilians is a war crime, a moral outrage, and an egregious violation of humanitarian law.**
[Please sign on now to become a grassroots co-sponsor of the _Ceasefire Now Resolution_.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139180?t=1&akid=31428%2E1203867%2ETHLvKX)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139180?t=2&akid=31428%2E1203867%2ETHLvKX)**
**We need legislation that saves as many lives as possible, no matter one’s faith or ethnicity.** So I’m joining some of my colleagues and a growing coalition of human rights advocates in calling for de-escalation, ceasefire, and a strong humanitarian response that prevents more devastating civilian casualties across the region.
The answer to war crimes is not war crimes.
Since Saturday October 7, Israel’s government has been dropping around a thousand bombs a day on 2.2 million trapped Palestinians—over half of whom are children. This includes white phosphorus bombs, an illegal incendiary weapon that burns through skin down to the bone.
As of Monday, October 16, the UN and the WHO reported that 1 million Palestinians have been displaced, and Israel’s military has targeted 111 medical facilities, killed 12 health care workers, and bombed 60 ambulances. Recent reports indicate hundreds have been killed in the bombing of a hospital sheltering thousands of civilians.
Calling Palestinians “animals,” Israeli politicians have openly broadcast their collective punishment of civilians. The Israeli government has cut off water, food, fuel, medicine, and electricity to Gaza, while refusing to accept Palestinian Americans from Gaza or to allow the delivery of humanitarian aid into Gaza.
As Jewish group IfNotNow said while supporting the _Ceasefire Now Resolution: “Even as Biden allows Israel's genocide of Palestinians, we will not allow more mass murder in our name.”_
**Unfortunately, many U.S. political leaders are supporting this violence and calling to send more weapons to Israel’s military, while dehumanizing and disregarding Palestinian civilians.** The Biden administration, most of Congress, and U.S. State Department officials have actively tried to silence calls for de-escalation and a ceasefire.
The hate and racist rhetoric coming out of Washington D.C. is pushing incendiary, hateful, and dehumanizing anti-Palestinian and anti-Muslim rhetoric that must be called out. A 6-year-old boy—Wadea Al-Fayoume—was stabbed to death in Chicago for being Palestinian American.
My colleagues are trying to silence me, the only Palestinian American in Congress, because I want the violence to stop—no matter whether it’s toward Israelis or toward Palestinians. I cannot believe I have to beg our country to value every human life, no matter their faith or ethnicity. We cannot lose sight of the humanity in each other.
[Please sign if you agree: The U.S. government must urgently save Palestinian, Israeli, and American civilian lives. We must bring Americans in Israel and occupied Palestine safely home, and we must push Israel’s government to stop the siege on Gaza and ensure humanitarian aid to Gaza.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139180?t=3&akid=31428%2E1203867%2ETHLvKX)
**[SIGN NOW](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139180?t=4&akid=31428%2E1203867%2ETHLvKX)**
Thank you for taking action.
Right now, we must keep showing massive public support for ending the violence. And in the long-term, we must keep building the movement to end the Israeli government’s apartheid system against Palestinians. Everyone in the region deserves to live safely, in freedom and with equal rights.
In solidarity,
Rep. Rashida Tlaib

Hundreds of Jewish Americans have been arrested while protesting to end the Israeli military’s unfolding genocide against Palestinians, and thousands blocked entrances to the White House on Monday calling for a ceasefire. In Congress, I just joined 12 other Democrats to introduce the Ceasefire Now Resolution , urging the Biden administration to call for an immediate de-escalation and ceasefire in Israel and occupied Palestine, and to send humanitarian aid and assistance to people under siege and trapped in Gaza. The collective punishment of Palestinian civilians is a war crime, a moral outrage, and an egregious violation of humanitarian law. We need legislation that saves as many lives as possible, no matter one’s faith or ethnicity. So I’m joining some of my colleagues and a growing coalition of human rights advocates in calling for de-escalation, ceasefire, and a strong humanitarian response that prevents more devastating civilian casualties across the region. The answer to war crimes is not war crimes. Since Saturday October 7, Israel’s government has been dropping around a thousand bombs a day on 2.2 million trapped Palestinians—over half of whom are children. This includes white phosphorus bombs, an illegal incendiary weapon that burns through skin down to the bone. As of Monday, October 16, the UN and the WHO reported that 1 million Palestinians have been displaced, and Israel’s military has targeted 111 medical facilities, killed 12 health care workers, and bombed 60 ambulances. Recent reports indicate hundreds have been killed in the bombing of a hospital sheltering thousands of civilians. Calling Palestinians “animals,” Israeli politicians have openly broadcast their collective punishment of civilians. The Israeli government has cut off water, food, fuel, medicine, and electricity to Gaza, while refusing to accept Palestinian Americans from Gaza or to allow the delivery of humanitarian aid into Gaza. As Jewish group IfNotNow said while supporting the Ceasefire Now Resolution: “Even as Biden allows Israel's genocide of Palestinians, we will not allow more mass murder in our name.” Unfortunately, many U.S. political leaders are supporting this violence and calling to send more weapons to Israel’s military, while dehumanizing and disregarding Palestinian civilians. The Biden administration, most of Congress, and U.S. State Department officials have actively tried to silence calls for de-escalation and a ceasefire. The hate and racist rhetoric coming out of Washington D.C. is pushing incendiary, hateful, and dehumanizing anti-Palestinian and anti-Muslim rhetoric that must be called out. A 6-year-old boy—Wadea Al-Fayoume—was stabbed to death in Chicago for being Palestinian American. My colleagues are trying to silence me, the only Palestinian American in Congress, because I want the violence to stop—no matter whether it’s toward Israelis or toward Palestinians. I cannot believe I have to beg our country to value every human life, no matter their faith or ethnicity. We cannot lose sight of the humanity in each other. Thank you for taking action. Right now, we must keep showing massive public support for ending the violence. And in the long-term, we must keep building the movement to end the Israeli government’s apartheid system against Palestinians. Everyone in the region deserves to live safely, in freedom and with equal rights. In solidarity, Rep. Rashida Tlaib Not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. ** _Includes Courtroom Footage Of Trum_ p **ARLINGTON, VA —** With foreign affairs front and center, Tell It Like It Is PAC released its latest television ad of the 2024 cycle. Entitled “Dangerous World,” the :30 second spot is a six-figure buy that will air statewide in New Hampshire on broadcast and cable and across digital platforms in New Hampshire and South Carolina. Released one day after Governor Christie filed his paperwork for the New Hampshire primary and one day before he attends a town hall meeting in Charleston, South Carolina, the ad includes footage of Christie’s trip to Ukraine this summer where he visited with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, as well as footage from a previous trip to Israel where he met Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The ad also includes a shot of former president Donald Trump sitting in a Manhattan courtroom on October 2, 2023 during the opening day of the New York civil case against him and his company. The spot emphasizes the failings of both the Biden and Trump foreign policy record. Biden oversaw the catastrophic surrender in Afghanistan, while Trump’s isolationist views will only embolden our enemies. Governor Christie has [stated](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=10041ad395&e=d0a9afa930), “When America leaves the leadership of the world the despots of the world—the Taliban, Putin, the Mullahs, China & North Korea fill the vacuum. Chaos and violence are the result.”

**“Dangerous World”**
[](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=a8607b40d1&e=d0a9afa930)
**TRANSCRIPT FOR “DANGEROUS WORLD” (:30)**
**VO:**_In a dangerous world, America must lead.____And our next president must be up to the challenge, Not distracted by personal issues.____Experienced - with a proven record of strong leadership.
__To stand up for democracy, the rule of law.__
Abroad, and at home_.___A president who can govern and isn’t afraid of the truth.____Chris Christie, President.____Tell It Like It Is Pac is responsible for the content of this advertisement._

---

**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

Let's be honest, very few people want to wear hearing aids. Although there have been huge breakthroughs in technology, most people don't use them simply because they think they are still big and ugly. However, Marco and Paul wanted to change this perception with a **revolutionary device developed with top German hearing aid engineers formerly from Siemens.**

But now, a **game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry** , and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they’ve seen in over a decade.

It’s called **Horizon by hear.com.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time--when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **Horizon has taken the U.S. by storm since its release in early 2023** , offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.
[ Check if you qualify ](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c671661%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=uhK806pgyG1OMznUPhl1SQ&sysid=1)
[ ](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c671660%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Lggc51t2H37DljLyLSIVOg&sysid=1)
What makes Horizon so special?

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

With Horizon, they can. **Imagine effortless hearing in every situation** --restaurants, weddings, block parties, and beyond. Imagine being able to **understand every word clearly** with a device so small and comfortable, you’ll completely forget you’re wearing it.

This means that Horizon offers all of the usual benefits of a modern hearing aid--from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming--with the added bonus of something completely new: it can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

“It’s not just about volume,” explains hear.com founder Paul Crusius. “It’s about speech clarity. And that’s precisely what Horizon is designed to optimize.”

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity --and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

subject: Betsy DeVos’ mind-blowing tweet
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=740%2E135344%2E3mAumX)

Friend,
As Michiganders know, for decades the DeVos family’s #1 issue has been weakening Michigan's, and the country's, public education system. Betsy DeVos used Michigan as her petri dish before becoming Trump’s Secretary of Education, and his longest serving cabinet secretary – just about the full four years. That’s why Betsy DeVos’ tweet and article this week are particularly head-shaking:
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct23.ttRNnI&refcode=em231020-1-30&t=2&akid=740%2E135344%2E3mAumX)
She’s finally saying the quiet part out loud: Betsy DeVos was Trump’s longest serving cabinet secretary and oversaw a department she didn’t even believe should exist. She took a salary and traveled on the taxpayers’ dime, all while working to run the organization she was leading into the ground.
But that fight didn’t end when Betsy DeVos left her cabinet position. For years, the DeVos family has funded candidates who will push their particular policies at the national level. And just this week, we got a glimpse into who they’re backing to be Michigan’s next Senator when former Congressman Mike Rogers filed his FEC report. **In the first month of his campaign, the DeVos family has shown they’re all-in on sending Mike Rogers to the Senate – contributing over $46,200, all in one day.**
We know that this is just the beginning of the support Mike Rogers will receive from big money donors. This is why we’re asking: [**Will you help us push back against the influence of the DeVos family in our race by chipping in $3 today? It really does all add up – their big checks don’t hold a candle to the power of lots and lots of people giving a little at a time.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct23.ttRNnI&refcode=em231020-1-30&t=3&akid=740%2E135344%2E3mAumX)**

Thank you,
Team Slotkin

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: This is what it looks like when government looks out for families, not corporate interests
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=105%2E4032634%2El2jan_)
---
Big tax prep companies — like H&R Block and TurboTax — have fought and lobbied to make the tax-filing process as time-consuming and wallet-emptying as possible for you all so they can maximize profits. They’ve succeeded, too. On average the tax filing process takes Americans eight hours and $140 to complete — and tax filing is a billion-dollar industry. **So for years, I’ve fought back. I’ve advocated for fast, free filing for taxpayers. Now we’re one step closer: The IRS just officially announced a free pilot program launching next year — available in 13 states, including Massachusetts. Woo-hoo!** [**We’ve seen that when we fight to make our government work for working people, we win. Can you make a donation of $28 or any amount to support our re-election campaign and strengthen our movement for bold reform like this?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/818?amount=28&t=8&akid=105%2E4032634%2El2jan_) Let me back up and explain how we got to this point. Every year, when your W2s come in the mail, your employer has already sent a copy to the government. Yep, they already know how much you make and owe before you file your taxes. So the IRS could theoretically streamline the tax filing process for you by using information they already have. But tax prep companies have spent decades, and tens of millions of dollars, lobbying Washington to make tax filing as much of a hassle as possible and prevent an easy, free option. And in this fight, Republicans sided with these giant tax prep companies, demanding that the IRS stop “competing” with private companies. (Please.) So these companies and their lobbyists brokered a deal — a deal that was good for them, and lousy for us. They promised to offer low-income Americans free tax prep software, and in exchange, the IRS wouldn’t make a free filing program of their own, for everyone. Here’s the thing: These companies purposefully undermined their own free filing options — hiding them from search engine results and using slick designs and upsell tactics to trick taxpayers into paying more. So I urged the IRS to make actual free and easy filing a reality — in legislation, in hearings, in letters, in explainers, you name it. Supporters like you also raised your voices — in petitions, on social media, in messages to elected officials, and more. And last year, we made huge progress in this fight. Democrats included funding for the program in the Inflation Reduction Act, and the next year, the IRS announced they’d launch a pilot program. But the tax prep giants sprang into action as soon as the IRS announced this program. They hired fancy lobbyists. They launched a slick campaign to stop this from happening. And MAGA House Republicans pushed back too — because they wanted to look out for these rich corporations. But we kept pushing back. And now, finally, the IRS is moving forward with the pilot program, and it has announced that a number of taxpayers in 13 states — including Massachusetts — will be able to use the program to file tax returns digitally and free of charge in the 2024 tax season. Sometimes, fighting for change like this feels like pushing a boulder up a never-ending hill. But if you keep going, and going, and going, you finally glimpse sunlight streaming over the top of the hill — and you know you’re making progress. This is what it looks like when government looks out for families, not corporate interests — and this is what we can achieve when we stay in the fight. Side by side. [**Thank you for everything you do to help make big, structural change that touches people’s lives. And if it makes sense for you right now, please pitch in with a donation to help show the momentum behind our movement right now.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/818?t=9&akid=105%2E4032634%2El2jan_)

---
Friend Over the past half century, Lyndon and Helga Zepp-LaRouche have consistently promoted in-depth infrastructure and other economic development plans and projects in the interest of securing a lasting peace among the world's powers. _Real_ peace is only possible with such a global new paradigm of economic development based on the Westphalian principle of the "benefit of the other," a principle which ended over a century of horrific religious warfare in Europe. Today, that Westphalian paradigm is alive and thriving in China's "win-win" Belt and Road Initiative, as well as in the peaceful collaboration of an increasing number of nations seen in the ongoing BRICS process. Join us tonight with my guest Jason Ross of the _Executive Intelligence Review_ as we further elaborate this process in which the LaRouches have played a central role over the years.
### [NY Symposium, Friday, October 20, 8:00 pm: The LaRouche Plan for Peace in Southwest Asia](https://www.sareforsenate.com/r?u=jalJvum2JQxpPvfjGmN5k6gcgUpOrIzj6BnToN9Gwno&e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20231020_symposium&n=2)

body:
Marketing assault weapons in video games intended for young audiences is irresponsible and dangerous.
#

Friends -
A new article from _The Wall Street Journal_ reveals shocking news:
**In the 2000s and early 2010s, gun manufacturer Remington made a deal with Activision, the maker of the Call of Duty video game franchise, to have one of their assault rifles placed in video games out of concern that “their customer base was aging.”**
Marketing military-style assault rifles to minors in the name of profit? To say we are outraged would be an understatement.
[**We must continue our work to defeat the gun lobby and denounce their insidious marketing tactics towards children. Will you chip in $3 today to help us fight back against their dangerous schemes to corrupt children?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-oct23.zcsGXG&refcode=em231020-1-30&t=1&akid=6757%2E3935704%2E_9nl9_)
**[DONATE](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-oct23.zcsGXG&refcode=em231020-1-30&t=2&akid=6757%2E3935704%2E_9nl9_)**
_The Wall Street Journal_ obtained a memo from Remington’s parent company that reads: _“With increasing urbanization and access to shooting/hunting areas in decline, a primary means for young potential shooters to come into contact with firearms and ammunition is through virtual gaming scenarios.”_
Marketing assault weapons in video games intended for young audiences is irresponsible and dangerous, much like tobacco companies marketing flavored e-cigarettes to young people. Developing minds can be easily influenced. Gun manufacturers owe it to the American people to market their products responsibly.
[**Our kids deserve better than to be influenced by the gun lobby’s dirty marketing tactics. Please, make a contribution to GIFFORDS PAC today to send a strong message that this community rejects gun manufacturers’ harmful marketing tactics towards children.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-oct23.zcsGXG&refcode=em231020-1-30&t=3&akid=6757%2E3935704%2E_9nl9_)

name: Gundry MD
subject: Dangers of eating spinach
body:
TheFederalistWire.com

Please read the following message
from our sponsor.

Spinach is often promoted as a
healthy green, but contains FAR more downsides than good sides...

Spinach is one of the highest
oxalate foods that's commonly eaten by modern humans (in addition
to beet greens, beets, almonds, and other veggies and nuts).

The amount of oxalates in a
serving of spinach is extremely high, up to 600 mg in a normal
sized bowl. The "safe" amount of oxalates in a daily diet
according to world renowned oxalate expert Sally Norton should be
between 100-200 mg per day total to avoid a lot of the health
problems caused by high oxalate plants.

So you can see how concerning
spinach is with these extremely high oxalate levels.

The problem with eating too much
oxalates too frequently is that it can cause serious issues such
as kidney stones, thyroid problems, gut damage, skin issues, and
joint pain.

In fact, some people have even
gotten "oxalate poisoning" by drinking green smoothies too often
and had to go to the ER for kidney failure.

In addition, the nutrients in
spinach such as calcium and iron are very poorly absorbed by the
human body, with a dismal 3-4% bioavailability. Compare that to
the very high bioavailability (high absorption) of nutrients like
iron and calcium in meat and dairy at 30-40% bioavailability.

Overall, I believe that spinach
has more cons than pros, and I avoid it. Dozens of my clients
and friends have also reported dramatically improved digestion
and less joint pain when eliminating leafy greens such as
spinach.

More problems with a particular
common vegetable below that could be damaging your gut and
hormones...

Broccoli vs Kale vs Green
Beans... (the #1 WORST veggie for your gut & energy)
According to the best-selling
author and world-renowned heart surgeon, Dr. Steven Gundry,
there's one veggie people over 40 should never eat.

This veggie can damage your gut
and disrupt your hormones... It contains a toxin that damages the
lining of your intestines, causes bloating, embarrassing gas, and
a bulging belly.

Do you know the veggie I'm
talking about? Make sure you do by clicking the one below you
think it is, and get the answer from Dr. Gundry himself on the
next page:

>> Green Beans

>> Broccoli

>> Kale

>> Cauliflower

clean_body: You don’t have the votes, Jim. | Team, We’re now 17 days since Kevin McCarthy’s ouster as Speaker of the House – and we still don’t have a new permanent Speaker. Right now, Jim Jordan remains the frontrunner to be the next Speaker – but after multiple votes, he’s still struggling to get enough support from his own party to move forward. What might happen next is up in the air: Rep. Jordan himself has flip-flopped multiple times in the last few days on his path forward. But one thing is very clear: the road to retaking the House next year – and denying that Speaker a Republican majority – runs right through Ohio. So we’re asking: = This chaos in the House has real consequences for our country. Even as the Senate and the White House work to advance policies to help American families, the House can’t get anything done. And a lot is on the line: We’re just a few weeks away from government funding running out, which would disrupt everything from food safety inspections to funding for early childhood education to food assistance to transportation and infrastructure projects. Derek, I wanted to make sure you saw the email our team sent earlier. A special election has been called, and while that doesn’t actually move Election Day, it allows big donors to give even bigger checks. That puts a people-powered campaign like ours at a disadvantage. [**Can you please chip in today to help us close the gap?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231020-1?refcode=EMAM20_1_SPE_20231020_V1_F&refcode2=31704_3422442_tJAzcR&akid=31704%2E3422442%2EtJAzcR)
* * *
Governor Newsom has officially called a special election in the race for California’s Senate seat. **Here’s what that means for us.**
_Quick refresh: After Senator Feinstein passed away, Newsom appointed Laphonza Butler to fulfill the remainder of her term. Senator Butler will serve through November 2024, and is not running in this race. California law allows a special election to take place alongside the normally scheduled election. The special election will elect someone who will serve from November 2024 through early January 2025, when all new Senators are sworn in._
**California will now have two elections side by side:**
1. To elect someone to serve November 2024-January 2025
2. To elect someone who will serve a normal six year term beginning in January 2025

The same candidates are running in both races, and there’s one really BIG consequence to that. Check out this Politico headline:
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231020-1?refcode=EMAM20_1_SPE_20231020_V1_F&refcode2=31704_3422442_tJAzcR&akid=31704%2E3422442%2EtJAzcR)
That's right, Derek, this race is going to get even more expensive. That’s because contribution limits have now doubled. **So folks who could afford to give $6,600 (the federal limit) can now give $13,200.**
That puts a grassroots powered campaign like ours at a massive disadvantage. Politico reported that as of June 30th, our opponent **Adam Schiff had 495 donors who had already given the max $6,600. If all of those donors gave another $6,600, he’d raise another $3.2 million.**
By comparison, we have 47 donors who have given the maximum, and 99% of our contributions are $100 or less.
Katie is SO proud to be running a grassroots powered campaign, but this unexpected change means we could be facing an even steeper cash deficit than we anticipated. **We know this team can help us make up the difference:** [**Can you chip in today?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231020-1?refcode=EMAM20_1_SPE_20231020_V1_F&refcode2=31704_3422442_tJAzcR&akid=31704%2E3422442%2EtJAzcR)

More to come,
Team Katie Porter

Katie is running for the U.S. Senate because Californians deserve a warrior fighting for them in Washington. Our campaign is people-powered, we don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, or executives from Big Oil or Big Pharma. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-footer?refcode=EMAM20_1_SPE_20231020_V1_F&t=2&refcode2=31704_3422442_tJAzcR&akid=31704%2E3422442%2EtJAzcR)**

Friend,
It is the honor of my lifetime to announce my candidacy for Georgia’s 2nd Congressional District. Peter, It's been 17 days since McCarthy was ousted as speaker — and Republicans are still no closer to selecting his replacement. Right now, we're less than a month away from a government shutdown and facing major crises that require U.S. leadership in Ukraine and Israel. **Still, MAGA Republicans are refusing to accept any potential speaker besides Jim Jordan — even though he doesn't have the votes to win.** Jordan has been in Congress for 16 years and has never passed a single piece of legislation, while consistently supporting an extreme and destructive agenda. He has sponsored a bill banning abortion nationally with no exceptions, consistently voted against funding the government, voted against the PACT Act to ensure healthcare for Veterans, and voted against certifying the 2020 election. In fact, as one of Donald Trump's closest allies, he helped orchestrate the January 6 insurrection, summoning masses of Trump's supporters to protest at the Capitol! Let's be clear – despite his record of obstruction and peddling conspiracy theories, 200 Republicans voted to make this man the speaker of the House. This is unacceptable.

This is not the time for partisan political games, Peter. **House Republicans have repeatedly shown they can't govern. One of their members even admitted, “We don't deserve the majority.”** At some point, congressional Republicans will realize that the only way forward is to work in a bipartisan fashion to select a speaker of the House. The only question is just how much failure and humiliation and chaos will ensue before that happens. clean_body: MAGA Republicans are refusing to accept any potential speaker besides Jim Jordan – even though he doesn’t have the votes to win. Peter, It's been 17 days since McCarthy was ousted as speaker — and Republicans are still no closer to selecting his replacement. Right now, we're less than a month away from a government shutdown and facing major crises that require U.S. leadership in Ukraine and Israel. Still, MAGA Republicans are refusing to accept any potential speaker besides Jim Jordan — even though he doesn't have the votes to win. Jordan has been in Congress for 16 years and has never passed a single piece of legislation, while consistently supporting an extreme and destructive agenda. He has sponsored a bill banning abortion nationally with no exceptions, consistently voted against funding the government, voted against the PACT Act to ensure healthcare for Veterans, and voted against certifying the 2020 election. In fact, as one of Donald Trump's closest allies, he helped orchestrate the January 6 insurrection, summoning masses of Trump's supporters to protest at the Capitol! Let's be clear – despite his record of obstruction and peddling conspiracy theories, 200 Republicans voted to make this man the speaker of the House. This is unacceptable. This is not the time for partisan political games, Peter. House Republicans have repeatedly shown they can't govern. One of their members even admitted, “We don't deserve the majority.” At some point, congressional Republicans will realize that the only way forward is to work in a bipartisan fashion to select a speaker of the House. The only question is just how much failure and humiliation and chaos will ensue before that happens. No matter who ends up holding the speaker's gavel, though, we need to do everything we can to take back the House next year – and that starts with winning in swing districts like WA-08. = | = Thank you, Kim Rep. Kim Schrier is a doctor, scientist, and mom, fighting for Washington's 8th District in Congress. Friend, Jim Jordan has now tried THREE TIMES to beat his colleagues into submission and win a vote to become Speaker...and he has now FAILED three times in a row. This is welcome news—but we can’t get complacent or take our eyes off the ball. Jordan is a mean, petty person who is only in politics to pursue power and to boost his own ego at the expense of _everything_ else. We saw this dynamic play out dramatically in Washington, D.C. this week as Jordan’s right wing allies and the Fox News disinformation and propaganda machine kicked into full gear to help Jordan bully his way into the Speaker’s office. **Members of Congress, members of Jordan’s own Republican Party, received countless death threats, calls and text messages intimidating and attempting to scare them into voting for Jordan as Speaker.** Many members even reported that their spouses—mostly women who are not engaged in the business of politics—were being personally harassed and threatened in this fear and anger campaign to bully the holdouts to Jordan’s quest for power into submission.[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71897557/433650652/1649708063?refcode=eoq3-thanksNGP&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS8xMDAwNjciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzIwYzU3ZjYtNmI2Zi1lZTExLWIwMDQtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=SVhsj2yO8KoS_Xu0G5c3V8gIPnRfgcwttw_J_404wjM=)

Wouldn’t you know it: this tactic DID NOT WORK. **Jordan’s clumsy attempt to mimic _House of Cards_ resulted in his own downfall—for now, at least.** We will stay vigilant and keep working as hard as possible to defeat Jordan and everything he stands for. That's why I am here, and why I am running for this office. We are at a critical point in American democracy; what we do here and now could determine the future and fate of our republic for generations to come. Please stand with me, and join this campaign to stop Jim Jordan’s divisive and dangerous leadership in Congress by helping me defeat Jordan this year—**[a contribution of $10 or more goes a long way in winning this fight for the future of our nation:](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71897562/433650654/1649708063?refcode=speaker-flameoutNGP&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS8xMDAwNjciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzIwYzU3ZjYtNmI2Zi1lZTExLWIwMDQtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=SVhsj2yO8KoS_Xu0G5c3V8gIPnRfgcwttw_J_404wjM=)**[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71897563/433650655/1649708063?refcode=stop-jordanNGP&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS8xMDAwNjciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzIwYzU3ZjYtNmI2Zi1lZTExLWIwMDQtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=SVhsj2yO8KoS_Xu0G5c3V8gIPnRfgcwttw_J_404wjM=)[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71897564/433650657/1649708063?refcode=eoq3-thanksNGP&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS8xMDAwNjciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzIwYzU3ZjYtNmI2Zi1lZTExLWIwMDQtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=SVhsj2yO8KoS_Xu0G5c3V8gIPnRfgcwttw_J_404wjM=)

| | THIS WEEK RURAL AMERICA AMERICANS UNITED kicked off its first media campaign, to formally introduce ourselves to the people of Washington State. The campaign is the first step in our [innovative plan](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/3aOirOEmH/c?w=Ar2OZtNan590_mF4bZqd01zI-OaEwAymQBSqhzbJ4NM.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9kcml2ZS5nb29nbGUuY29tL2ZpbGUvZC8xeUtEd1p2TzJyRFhTdDQ4WTNES3dzY3k1a3V1VHc3cVgvdmlldz91c3A9ZHJpdmVfbGluayIsInIiOiIxYjdlNDdjZC04Yjc2LTQ1NTktOWM1YS0yYWU4ZmJiZmVlNWEiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ) to turn the center of the state purple. Starting this week with a $350,000, 14-month media blitz, RAU will blanket the 4th District with 20,000 separate radio spots highlighting traditional Democratic Party values. The radio ads, in English and Spanish, are believed to be the largest public awareness campaign ever launched in the state. At this time, with right-wing messaging dominating public discourse, we estimate that 80 percent of the Central Washington population has never heard a positive Democratic message. We know it’s going to be a marathon, but this campaign will begin to change that. Along with advertisements, we have started a program of outreach to local newspapers, TV and radio stations, podcasts and blogs, beginning with our first news release, which you can read [here](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/3aOirOEmH/c?w=CyLQxrAe6DaKx_LYZ1xk-gtCJiu_n4cherlIaek8AhE.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9kcml2ZS5nb29nbGUuY29tL2ZpbGUvZC8xZEw2T2pycDRXMDFTS2ZxY2ZYTFg0VFBtT1E2N1N5RTIvdmlldz91c3A9c2hhcmluZyIsInIiOiIxYjdlNDdjZC04Yjc2LTQ1NTktOWM1YS0yYWU4ZmJiZmVlNWEiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ). We will be following up on the release with personal visits to newsrooms around the district, to introduce ourselves and our program to journalists who for years have been spoon-fed Republican propaganda. Just as we were finalizing the news release, the 4th District’s venal Congressman Dan Newhouse blessed us with a perfect example of why Central Washington is so sorely in need of organizations like RAU, which can provide residents with what may be their first exposure to core Democratic values. Newhouse, who clearly doesn’t believe himself in any way accountable to his electorate, voted several times to choose bullying, election-denying Jim Jordan to be Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives — an office that is next in line to the presidency in the event the president and vice president are sidelined. (Fortunately for all of us, Jordan lost.) Jordan, as you know, is a far-right extremist who has been accused of [ignoring hundreds of sexual abuse claims](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/3aOirOEmH/c?w=Zf0Hr5Uu7bNFxSVbrc4dwo7coWH6piONnVTvdW3qiM0.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cudGhlZGFpbHliZWFzdC5jb20vZXgtb3N1LXdyZXN0bGVyLWFkYW0tZGlzYWJhdG8tc2F5cy1qaW0tam9yZGFuLWNhbGxlZC1jcnlpbmctYmVnZ2luZy10by1kZW55LWFidXNlLWNsYWltcyIsInIiOiIxYjdlNDdjZC04Yjc2LTQ1NTktOWM1YS0yYWU4ZmJiZmVlNWEiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ) against Ohio State University team trainer Richard Strauss when Jordan was an assistant wrestling coach at the school. He was also among the leaders of the failed fascist Republican plot to overturn the results of the 2020 election. Let’s watch and see if he gets indicted. That Newhouse could vote for such a despicable human as Jordan to serve as the third-highest elected official in the land says a lot about Newhouse’s values — or lack thereof. A simple question we’d like to hear Newhouse answer: Is Jim Jordan the kind of man the people of your district should have as a role model for their children? In other RAU news ...

At this time, with right-wing messaging dominating public discourse, we estimate that 80 percent of the Central Washington population has never heard a positive Democratic message. Derek, over two years into President Biden’s historic term, I’m more proud than ever to be a member of his reelection campaign’s National Advisory Board – one of only four Pennsylvanians serving in that capacity.

Amid so much polarization and toxic misinformation, the President continues to right the ship after four damaging years. He’s remained laser-focused on the issues that matter most to the majority of Americans, demonstrating wisdom, experience, and determination. For example, he’s:
✅ Confirmed Supreme Court Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson
✅ Enacted the first major piece of gun safety legislation in nearly three decades
✅ Passed the Chips and Science Act, which invests in semiconductor manufacturing here in PA-06
✅ Put the U.S. on a path to cut emissions by 40% by the end of the decade
✅ Reduced prescription drug prices for many Americans

# **A Message from the Chairwoman**
---
| | _**Help Our Party by Working the Polls**_
---
Team, In less than three weeks, Hoosiers in municipalities across the state will decide their leadership for the next four years. As we have discussed, please get involved in get out the vote operations in a city or town nearest you to help our Republican candidates cross the finish line. While helping with GOTV is extremely important, there is another way in which each county party and municipality needs your help, and that is working the polls. As you know, in order to make elections happen it takes Republican and Democrat volunteers to help work the polls and ensure election integrity. If you are still looking for a way to make a positive difference this fall, please take the time to sign up to help work the polls in your municipal election. This crucial civic duty not only enables us to put on elections, it is a crucial component to make sure each ballot is counted in a fair and transparent way. Please take a minute and [sign up here to become a poll worker](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/4d6b85bff64cc4583947229f28c3afba/94096490f8a27e8ec3d6b838967d376c/40313 "https://www.indiana.gop/join-team") or reach out to your local county party to get involved in the election process. With your help, we can continue to make sure Indiana has safe and secure elections.
---
---
Chairwoman Anne F. Hathaway
---
| |
# **Governor Eric Holcomb's Week in Review**
---
| |
# **🍂 _Gov. Holcomb celebrates Next Level Trails expansion of Vandalia Trail in Plainfield_**
---
---
| | Governor Eric J. Holcomb today joined the Indiana Department of Natural Resources (DNR), the town of Plainfield, the Indiana Economic Development Corporation (IEDC), and New City Development to celebrate the official opening of the recently completed Vandalia Trail extension and to mark the start of a new chapter for Hobbs Station. “Powered by partnerships, and blazing new trails, Next Level Trails continues to help Indiana connect communities and one another,” said Gov. Holcomb. “I’m excited to see the private sector, local and state government partners all come together to set a new national standard. The Vandalia Trail connection to Plainfield’s new Hobbs Station development perfectly represents our statewide momentum and will draw Hoosiers across the region for years to come.” **What else happened this week?****Gov. Holcomb**[s](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/4d6b85bff64cc4583947229f28c3afba/ac9109db592c025ec3d6b838967d376c/40313)[hared an update](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/4d6b85bff64cc4583947229f28c3afba/10c60ef0bceee2bbc3d6b838967d376c/40313) on the My Healthy Baby program.****

body:

My name is Peter Koutoujian and I’m the Sheriff of Middlesex County, Massachusetts. Prior to that, I spent my career working in public health as a former legislator and in public safety as a prosecutor and a public defender.

I’m also one of the few elected Armenian-Americans in the entire country, and that’s why I’m writing you today. My friend Jirair Ratevosian is running to represent CA-30 in Congress. I met Jirair over ten years ago in Boston, campaigning for genocide recognition in Darfur, a painful fight that we Armenians know well. Right away, I knew he would go far. | [Support Jirair’s campaign here →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71899318/433656793/-377887102?amount=20&refcode=SBD_JR_EM_FR_102023_1_1_Peter&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYxNDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYmFiMjQ5N2UtNzI2Zi1lZTExLWIwMDQtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=w340h9LCvlqoiKKaVS7w1PTy87uZVX7XHMS4BtFoc2o=)

Jirair has a long track record of public service. He served as a Legislative Director for Congresswoman Barbara Lee and as a Senior Health Advisor to President Biden.

Jirair and I have bonded over our shared passion for making health care accessible and affordable. As the former Chair of Public Health myself, I know how important it is to have a doctor and public health professional in Congress.

Finally, Jirair would represent a diverse district with one of the highest Armenian populations in the country. As an elected Armenian myself, I can speak firsthand to how much representation matters to underrepresented communities. We need to ensure there is a strong Armenian voice in Congress that can hold Azerbaijan accountable.

**[Peter , in a crowded primary, Jirair stands out, and I’m honored to endorse him. | | Team, there’s a lot more to Nevada than just the glittering hustle and bustle of Las Vegas. Did you know that our state is the driest and the most mountainous in the country?
