| | I hope you folks are keeping your chins up during these trying times. The world has been through a real rough patch lately, with all of us stuck to our screens watching the heartbreaking situation in Gaza [unfold.](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=31a4e28c32264a418db2b5dee2570c96&_e=xm6I7c_HyxW41N60D6-4bwItXiyQ48tfoiXgSqej26zFZBM4LRU-1w-LFRxEm4J-kmZoqFSgrDu9Ubuf2cyRNgtqCekSXcVcqWl6gC2RPYRk4p9jVHngKNxcPSSVL9R9lsidDAp4nkU8F6Ge8UkMydwIEGLdWuqLUGmPURGch_OVhqmtLNCLaWw-Q-10P89LE0ldhZWBBouwMczwW-R0bwtSW4rudE9Ddo6d0383sxRJDwhiOwMfiC6-K82OmUNK5Xudg8sGDO9Y-HUPh0Y1bQ%3D%3D) My heart goes out to the victims who are [caught up in that turmoil](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=31a4e28c32264a418db2b5dee2570c96&_e=xm6I7c_HyxW41N60D6-4b0YmDo2kvqWTpesE1x5-vjbiFaMIrq-w6w7iVzVLHvGhfUaYMoljdkkRUCvLO_NPNCnOip_5d45-DOho0R8xGaFlze0EJwn7GWQscraI-qNcswiczRB8vstDsX0SLHBQxc0rHlAkysuV_-Gv5G_gq08HbpiDiz1GG6MdZpZWrCaMp48kc1PZDhsZYN_t0pq9WN3ZAXj4Rgw4ae_Ji4ZQvpIU1lCTV2gJsquW6cwPO7RntP9uxbErklrx6rSK0fSzOvFc3Ps_VI_4_4s0z0MKaFM%3D), and I can assure you my Republican colleagues and I are doing everything in our power to get Israel the aid they need to [end Hamas](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=31a4e28c32264a418db2b5dee2570c96&_e=xm6I7c_HyxW41N60D6-4b0YmDo2kvqWTpesE1x5-vja5ZMoX_QMsdWofqJx9l65ErXDwJ6OEoYlQFLTDb4wl17EnvJJUaopoTxrIFjxrz_kmrjE8CeJU-EtnfjnlBpB1ZrQt3U9IHf5pnCY3jNjE_xzftDig8tNwdaYm0O_WhIEIATRalyI2HI2CjeqDN772qAAntnSrEduJ2d3mB4I0bO_MGwXHzhTRXdm39vjT-FoHCf_hdgtfyhPUR5ANVS7sNmqKoDdDh_N_ZoZ3B6OYyntoP7oTwDimTfqVJVytVIechgCCw6wHmoQDYEkteNNNt9uNSwOUQPUDqbYyTPR0RQ%3D%3D) for good. But amidst all the destruction, I wanted to offer a bit of good news for your Friday—all the [sweat and toil](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=31a4e28c32264a418db2b5dee2570c96&_e=xm6I7c_HyxW41N60D6-4b-7UAZ7kou71zHBLi-xUQhKGr8pRBpoFm7Qx78Vf153hTXFwi2Uhpb937aC1t6_6bAEG_NPu_qIFacHZ_IHmeMV6iJaaT37HTkI_l_8Qbdcs8_QhyPN7YKZiuYYNIayK5T1EqGHbpJ7_ZEfpOo6h0kPQTGwkArxhyIJ6_kLcU5hUVDtnvgNr0VYFLlbwx1N6zlxqvFNz0DPM8O0i5P_iZwLTCtIZLMdMGnqvFKuMrFqQF8VyNJQUUUxN7WAOdxxOUVzyzVvhXmIOmXX9O5FHFOA%3D) we've put into the Unidentified Aerial Phenomena (UAP) hearings; it's not been for nothing. I'm thrilled to share that, as a member of the House of Representatives, I'll [soon have access](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=31a4e28c32264a418db2b5dee2570c96&_e=xm6I7c_HyxW41N60D6-4b677-2um4574914ZRQdvongpvgVnXMueaX3OVCeHJPPQWyaGWDI_fFhkbjgmUjE_JNezf3JjhfYLQjiTJmRb0ikw11S9Ia7cSRXpx72V2gkTeGqpgEt6J_O7U9lBaEYMMNa6P08wbM61Yd3OyfdcGHoRu-nZquXpDGlJq-y4bUD2pn0bn3SkoXx3qMiGRGlm7ZjJdTmyJigx2rMms2Pgiy1qlqUFVUkLtQ1bWs4rwK4XD7svlkx6nmS-5hoW00pGgA%3D%3D) to the classified Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility (SCIF) room. I and some other lawmakers will finally be able to take a close gander at the classified UAP documents that have been hidden under lock and key for Lord knows how long. This news has the Pentagon shaking in their boots—and rightfully so. They’ve been trying to [cover this up](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=31a4e28c32264a418db2b5dee2570c96&_e=xm6I7c_HyxW41N60D6-4b0YmDo2kvqWTpesE1x5-vjbH1C2CjTHcxSiJL1cF0Qje0wg8woVH1h__nFxkABUseRWyAld3NrwqM6TzAZu05G1viMFaNRjztfiLvsRjL9uq24_6T985nLffPPGqJk20bVVbQT7omzpBlb2rkcUISZzZ2-HQLy5XJLMYe7pa9czHM-4yRZglZypYGwe6do8HtvBoitIWd5_12lNIjhLD9vg%3D) since 1947 but now it’s not just my brave buddy [David Grusch](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=31a4e28c32264a418db2b5dee2570c96&_e=xm6I7c_HyxW41N60D6-4b0YmDo2kvqWTpesE1x5-vja98AKWYF89-aAEYpogmFPcnfBHzxaNEAzthmcv1ECi_mKh66idPzapmrQMeR-1rInDjAYgUwHR5qSmh8NuqLhZXZWrDBm8U5ymFGn4RSaaRcboAvLs5Gl_qOYJxL4UIrir8G-TamuLuqHovuWBX_4Oze9wLMY6QR_X6P1wmkAUk8JARe9nFEIV0Ka3--s6Gei_qGTZfirNM6SFf-DlvfrL_htBFCqMLlBFVmv4qeJzCeMQhjqgBT6OenwsXWfSKRE%3D) sounding the alarm bells; [more than half](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=31a4e28c32264a418db2b5dee2570c96&_e=xm6I7c_HyxW41N60D6-4b2WGzBeUXi9UsTp52eq40CuxIZwt6EcdXdKsdwOoFagKNkoiad6vl0SN8-EitSrHml2uBCE-zLryQcmy5_Bb6y3shd-f_TVaAX8KWsrIZBaYzeHCs08dD089x-_josnip48_xwpAcOrGkEFnNjOFC4ZPg5fheuOuKsiEuE1trKgfhTzPYnCyNAoSqhwjx3NSI7GVhU3Ce3iGYJSYwSrzK1CHA4r0m7-ArD3VmpbmoPLojRNBVsINAq1e8KhZKTM9tA%3D%3D) of America believes there is something else out there and they’re demanding answers now.
Back in July, when we first [busted through that barrier](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=31a4e28c32264a418db2b5dee2570c96&_e=xm6I7c_HyxW41N60D6-4b8qCtjv1qI5qqYlXlUPLV2UCEltE7zvXqYdruI5uyqI0UEZqnhkg2HzSKaw72a9FbxnZ9aYgOwiwgkHkBmM-dTwOGyeHFKUTtnHx1OhSvC7dYHgKR_Jsw01FuClknwyoxFAGOTas0P-cGRa7XhoZnAbqvmZsNQ33_05daMNtXUkmTHQAprsLyLGgQiGELGExpozuCgcxk6tY3yQQ9ZHgTkGrH9Y-OLwaCMdgIdPdV3OqQast4eFMMvhvsfNK2GMnSHAu-4HrDtIf7uytBc3493OoxPvPIbQQXONtMhypjlvP) and brought the truth out in the open, I made a real commitment to you all. I promised to keep on pushing, and now I'm delivering on that pledge. As I've been saying for years, what we really need is just some good old transparency. We don't need more cash, extra research, or any more excuses. What we're after are some dadgum honest answers and I am hopeful we’ll have them [before Christmas.](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=31a4e28c32264a418db2b5dee2570c96&_e=xm6I7c_HyxW41N60D6-4b1r8Pup7VvSFF25P5a9tbsMQ-W1zYEkU9hx9PQrAci7kHdfYhnUHtUo5pjcfqqWH7XA8X8fuKnZuu4oEeKgbPh61V80KPn3VhbVwhPergRqaUyhcgYNKpuat2fxfQdkdeOYUTf3SqBeNGrfBkZNAp4es7Wb6bLGsUKUhEBorPgVZNaXa8KlRvhihXQwUzYdFcpNhgEq9FN7vCfxDMQv-A56DotTpLA7Onf9nN5uNrjrViuHedGxRoy3bF56wauZAnw%3D%3D)

| | I want to remind my [Knoxville city readers that the general election is just around the corner](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=31a4e28c32264a418db2b5dee2570c96&_e=xm6I7c_HyxW41N60D6-4bx5UaPdy-VE-juu-0EzlEGibSQ85bDcpbkf11uAOmzdQWRmsHnFNMTvC09gyNb2Y3Lqtmrwd_NmOE2k0L2XqMXt6x9y-Qf_7nm4jCyENf996JRSZyMId5kAJ98pvbv1w46Cih9RPviEjTnw_J0eQCNNWcJcqdVVYsFpOyO0kWdn4ni-BG_FpAwgiJ7-BA9dl1EyJEiYJ2gvaWweLEeY2mD0d-PnWzWW0uelvRa-0MHkRXwMbe3ydduIvf3ACwIF58HhM5T0duQGl1ob1IWNXsjgtTGFtN0N8T2kyOAHoXas7), and it's your time to make your voices heard. Please keep in mind that this privilege is reserved for city residents. Early voting kicks off on Wednesday, October 18, and runs through Thursday, November 2. The big day, Election Day, is Tuesday, November 7. If you're eager to cast your ballot early, you can find a handy list of early voting locations and schedules on the [Knox County Election Commission's website.](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=31a4e28c32264a418db2b5dee2570c96&_e=xm6I7c_HyxW41N60D6-4b800V3OL2o9J2Q4pcEiqgIH6FA6UL48ZC2wsQwpAEv4cc4R5JI1vMU1rh6n_9IEmVkNikzkmqS-8xvYnQ_EJmWbSpHh2EGU7Snwrhydp9xJSjTNzgCXxRfncELcaCMgePMcdu2F1NK4cUntW2pdHyndRbErQFIfjHIOQhpF62Gj6qPKfEwvjxCmvJewjsuOquaNtgotHBHPsYWHLBMUpwHY%3D) Voting is more than just a civic duty; it's a fundamental privilege that should be cherished and exercised. It's your chance to have a say in the direction of our city, to make a difference in our communities. So, mark those dates on your calendar and be sure to get out there and vote!

But after the third vote, when Jim Jordan continued to lose support, House Republicans voted internally to move forward with a new, yet-to-be-determined Speaker nominee.
I said on Sunday that the "pressure campaign" against Republicans opposed to Jim \- especially from online personalities - would backfire and would solidify the opposition to Jordan's candidacy for Speaker of the House. Well, that's exactly what happened.
The families of Republicans voting against Jim Jordan were even receiving death threats, which is completely unacceptable and disgusting.
Again, I voted for Jim Jordan multiple times and wanted him to become Speaker. But those who called themselves Jordan's "allies" disrupted his campaign every step of the way and now we need to move forward with a different candidate.
It's time for Republicans to come together and elect a new Speaker so we can get back to work for the American people. I am hoping that we will get this over with next week and return to our important work of legislating and addressing the challenges facing our country.

name: Salud Carbajal
subject: I'm endorsing Adam Schiff
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Salud Carbajal for Congress
body:
I’m proud to share with you today my strong support for Adam Schiff’s campaign to represent California in the U.S. Senate.

Will you join me in supporting Adam’s candidacy and endorse him today? Visit https://act.adamschiff.com/signup/endorse-adam/ to add your name.

Simply put, Adam is the most effective leader we can send to the Senate. He builds consensus and works with people of different backgrounds and viewpoints to get things done.

When our democracy was on the line, Adam led the fight to impeach Trump and hold January 6 insurrectionists accountable. Because he doesn’t back down. When he takes on the big fights — whether it’s Trump, big corporations, or big bullies attacking working people — he wins.

And he will never back down when our values are at stake.

As an Assistant U.S. Attorney, he successfully prosecuted the first FBI agent (turned Russian spy) convicted of espionage.

And he held polluters and toxic waste dumpers accountable. His work led to the creation of the first federal environmental crimes unit in Los Angeles.

And he’s helped lead the way on some of the most important legislative priorities to Californians:

Fighting to create more affordable housing and address the homelessness crisis. Getting the Affordable Care Act passed. Investing the most ever in clean energy.

That’s what Adam Schiff does, and why I’m proud to support him. So I’ll ask you one more time:

Please, will you visit https://act.adamschiff.com/signup/endorse-adam/ and join me in supporting Adam Schiff’s U.S. Senate campaign?

I couldn’t be more grateful that there are folks as committed as you to making California the best it can be.

Thank you,
Salud Carbajal

name: Jocelyn Benson
subject: What you told me about democracy
disclaimer_text:
Paid for by
Jocelyn Benson for Secretary of State
body:
[https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif] Friend, [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif]
To everyone who took the time to tell me about the work you’re doing to protect democracy in your community — thank you.
Democracy wins when we use our voices and stay informed. I was really encouraged to read the numerous ways you plan to participate in and safeguard our elections.
A resident of Wayne County told me that she uses her vacation time to work as a poll worker. Another Michigander told me that the first thing she plans to do when she moves to her new county is register to vote at her local secretary of state office. Another, from Grand Rapids, shared that his greatest fear is that the takeovers of election systems by election deniers that he is seeing in other states could happen anywhere.
Here’s my main takeaway from all of your responses. We have a dedicated community of pro-democracy activists out there in Michigan and across the country. Thousands of you are reading this email right now. And while you might not know each other, you’re bonded by your common belief that democracy is under threat, but the vast majority of Americans are ready to fight to protect it.
That’s why I started Michigan Legacy PAC: to ensure we defend democracy, together. With nearly a year until the 2024 election, we’re building out our operation to make sure democracy wins up and down the ballot next year. Can you pitch in today to help support that work? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michiganlegacypac?refcode=102023]
In the coming year, our charge is to keep working and fighting together to ensure we build the infrastructure necessary to win the battle for our democracy — electing pro-democracy candidates up and down the ticket, enacting pro-voter policies and supporting the clerks who implement them, as well as educating every citizen about their rights and options to vote in our state.
So I urge you to continue to make your voice heard. Spread awareness to your friends, family, and fellow community members. When the time comes, vote. And make sure everyone you know heads to the ballot box too.
And if you can take action and pitch in a contribution now to help support my effort to defend democracy, I’d really appreciate it. The work starts now. I need you on board. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michiganlegacypac?refcode=102023]
Onward,
Jocelyn

From: **Rashida Tlaib******

Subject: Join the call for an immediate de-escalation and ceasefire in Israel and occupied Palestine, and to send humanitarian aid and assistance to people under siege and trapped in Gaza.
To: dpwillis67@gmail.com
Friend,
Over this past week, tens of thousands of people have rallied in cities across the U.S. for a ceasefire. Over 100 Jewish Americans have been arrested while protesting to end the Israeli military’s unfolding genocide against Palestinians, and thousands blocked entrances to the White House on Monday calling for a ceasefire.

_We are in an information crisis._ 185 million Americans don’t trust the news, because people simply don’t know which sources to rely on for factual information anymore.
From the far-right propaganda and dangerous rhetoric coming out of Fox News to the profit-driven behavior of mainstream news networks, our communities are in desperate need of truthful journalism they can trust.
**Now more than ever, America needs Courier.**

#
Hey Derek,
Even though it's an “off-year” there are some *big* elections in just a few weeks, in PA and around the country.
**Down in Virginia, our neighbors are fighting off MAGA extremists that are trying to take control of the state government.** They're just a few seats shy of having the votes to change VA's laws across the board, _including banning abortion._
And what happens in Virginia will have a big impact on everybody. Just like PA, winning VA requires building a movement and a message that can win in urban *and* rural areas. MAGA extremists are testing out their 2024 playbook, and if they succeed, they'll use that strategy to try to flip every swing state red 🔴 next year -- including Pennsylvania.
Early votes are already being cast, so there's only a few weeks left to reject MAGA extremism.
**[So I'm reaching out to ask: Can you help Democrats in Virginia by splitting a donation between our campaign + the Democratic Party of Virginia's Majority Project today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20231020-1?refcode=em20231020-1-8628&refcode2=8628_434096_Awrn_K&akid=8628%2E434096%2EAwrn_K)**

I say it so much because it's true: Every county, every vote is the only way to win.
Thanks for your support!

name: =?utf-8?Q?Margarita=20Wilkinson?=
subject: I need your help to DEFEND our Republican Majority
body:
Can I count on your support? | | | | |
---

Friend - Margarita Wilkinson here. I'm running for Congress to be the voice for your values in Washington, D.C., **and I need your help to get there.**
I'll cut to the chase – _**our race is a game-changer.**_ It's not only about our District; it's about deciding the Republican Majority in Congress. **It's about the future of our great nation.**
**I want to fight for the values that make the United States of America the most exceptional nation on earth.**
[](https://vote4margarita.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=daff3f9d4e72dc7794c68a0d7&id=c444aaba22&e=1f98559b5d)

My story:
I was born in Mexico to a teenage single mother and came to America as a child, growing up along the US-Mexico border. America was our beacon of hope. The promise of a better life was ours if we were willing to work for it.
I learned to speak English, worked my way through school, and took a job with the local Univision affiliate, serving as the eyes and ears for my community. Over 32 years, I climbed from office assistant to the youngest station manager in the company history. I earned my citizenship and got involved in the community.
People have forgotten what makes America great. But not me. I know the American Dream because I've lived the American dream - and I’ve never taken the freedom and opportunities America has given me for granted.
**I believe in the country that gave me an opportunity and I won’t stand by while extreme leftists dismantle the opportunities I had.**
Friend, we know that Washington is broken. Our Congress is no longer working on behalf of the people it was designed to serve. Our Southern Border is wide open, crime and drugs are decimating our communities, and the cost of living in Southern California has made the American Dream unattainable for too many young people. It doesn't have to be this way.
Congressman Mike Levin is part of the dysfunction in Washington - a rubber stamp for Joe Biden's America Last policies who caters to the far-left's destructive vision for our nation. We can't afford to send the same politicians to D.C. who aren't willing to stand up for our values and way of life.
_**I am still PROUD to be an American and I believe the America we know and love is worth fighting for.**_
**But here's the deal: I can't do this alone.** With the future of our nation's leadership hanging in the balance, your support could not be more crucial to flipping our seat RED.
**Every dollar you donate, every hour you volunteer, and every conversation you have with friends will make a real difference in the direction of our country. Together, we can make sure our voices are heard loud and clear in Congress.**
[_Will you chip in $25, $50, or even $100 to help us FLIP our seat and secure a Republican Majority in 2024?_](https://vote4margarita.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=daff3f9d4e72dc7794c68a0d7&id=aa697cfe3c&e=1f98559b5d)

-Margarita Wilkinson

Our Southern Border is wide open, crime and drugs are decimating our communities, and the cost of living in Southern California has made the American Dream unattainable for too many young people. It doesn't have to be this way. Congressman Mike Levin is part of the dysfunction in Washington - a rubber stamp for Joe Biden's America Last policies who caters to the far-left's destructive vision for our nation. We can't afford to send the same politicians to D.C. who aren't willing to stand up for our values and way of life. I am still PROUD to be an American and I believe the America we know and love is worth fighting for. But here's the deal: I can't do this alone. With the future of our nation's leadership hanging in the balance, your support could not be more crucial to flipping our seat RED. Every dollar you donate, every hour you volunteer, and every conversation you have with friends will make a real difference in the direction of our country. Together, we can make sure our voices are heard loud and clear in Congress. | | | | Thank you for being part of the team and for your incredible support. -Margarita Wilkinson | | | | Copyright (C) 2023 Margarita Wilkinson for Congress 2024. subject: Why I'm Running
body:
| | | | | |
---
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=cfa97a99fe&e=0a12281e0e)
|
---
Hey there its Mariela Roca, Republican Candidate running for Congress here in Maryland’s 6th Congressional District.
First, I want to let you know how grateful I am for your support. Generosity from grassroots supporters like you is the reason I am able to fund my campaign and fight for America’s future.

Now, I want to take a few minutes to share something personal with you: Why I’m running for Congress.
[**Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution to help boost my campaign’s momentum and WIN BACK Maryland’s 6th Congressional District!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=1717927415&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for Congress because I was raised by a single mom in Puerto Rico who always showed me how hard work and determination is what makes us all live the American dream. I learned english when I was 5 years old, and from that young age always felt so proud to be an American.
I’m running for Congress as a military veteran. I began my journey of service to our nation in 2005 when I joined the U.S. Air Force at the age of 20. During my military service I had the honor of serving my county abroad in the Global War on Terror, serving within the Task Force Medical and the Bagram Theater Internment Facility (BTIF) in Bagram, Afghanistan, during Operation Enduring Freedom in 2007. I know what sacrifice looks like - and this is why I love my country so much.
I’m running for my kids, your kids, and your grandkids. Everything that I do in my life is to make the best possible future for my daughter and my son and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has offered me my entire life.
[**I’M RUNNING FOR CONGRESS BECAUSE WE HAVE A COUNTRY TO SAVE!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=f3f14d5cbb&e=0a12281e0e)
Even during our most challenging moments, we are fortunate to call America our home. But it's clear that under the Biden administration, we face significant challenges, our prospects are dwindling, we are weak on the world stage, our economy is failing, and American families are being left behind every single day.
[**I’m running for Congress because America can do better with leaders that will always fight for America first. No matter what.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=d7c7a9b00c&e=0a12281e0e)
**As a military veteran** , I intimately understand the profound significance of service and the willingness to make the ultimate sacrifice for my country. My time in the military taught me the unwavering commitment to duty, honor, and the defense of freedom. It's a bond that transcends words; a deep-seated connection with the men and women I served alongside, many of whom paid the ultimate price. I've witnessed the selflessness, courage, and dedication that define the character of those who choose to protect their nation.
**As a medical logistician** , my mission was to ensure that our dedicated warfighters had the essential tools and supplies required to save lives on the frontlines. I understood the critical nature of my role in providing our troops with the medical resources and equipment they needed to deliver immediate care in challenging and high-stress situations. I am now prepared to take the knowledge, commitment, and understanding I gained in that role with me to Congress, where I will tirelessly advocate for policies that will support our country, military and American families first. Above anything.
**As a mother,** I understand firsthand the deep commitment and love that comes with the responsibility of providing for one's family. In the countless roles we take on as parents - caregiver, protector, educator, and provider - we become intimately acquainted with the challenges and triumphs of family life. We witness the struggles that many families face, whether it's making ends meet, securing access to quality education, or ensuring our children have the healthcare they need. It's in these moments that we are inspired to take action, to advocate for better opportunities, and to fight for a brighter future for our families.
I know how to make our community, district, and America strong and proud because i’ve done it before. [**And i’ll do it again as your next Congresswoman.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=0071528e60&e=0a12281e0e)
As your next Congresswoman for Maryland’s 6th Congressional District I will always fight for policies that will revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s out of control spending, champion school choice & parental rights, and save America’s future.
**But, in order to do this, I need your support today so I can spread this message to everyone across our district and country.**
[**Will you chip in today to help me win this fight for our nation’s future?**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=aa8b7abb31&e=0a12281e0e)
Together we **WILL** flip Maryland’s 6th Congressional District for Republicans and make America strong and proud again.
Sincerely,
Mariela Roca

I know what sacrifice looks like - and this is why I love my country so much. I’m running for my kids, your kids, and your grandkids. Everything that I do in my life is to make the best possible future for my daughter and my son and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has offered me my entire life. Even during our most challenging moments, we are fortunate to call America our home. But it's clear that under the Biden administration, we face significant challenges, our prospects are dwindling, we are weak on the world stage, our economy is failing, and American families are being left behind every single day. As a military veteran , I intimately understand the profound significance of service and the willingness to make the ultimate sacrifice for my country. My time in the military taught me the unwavering commitment to duty, honor, and the defense of freedom. It's a bond that transcends words; a deep-seated connection with the men and women I served alongside, many of whom paid the ultimate price. I've witnessed the selflessness, courage, and dedication that define the character of those who choose to protect their nation. As a medical logistician , my mission was to ensure that our dedicated warfighters had the essential tools and supplies required to save lives on the frontlines. I understood the critical nature of my role in providing our troops with the medical resources and equipment they needed to deliver immediate care in challenging and high-stress situations. I am now prepared to take the knowledge, commitment, and understanding I gained in that role with me to Congress, where I will tirelessly advocate for policies that will support our country, military and American families first. Above anything. As a mother, I understand firsthand the deep commitment and love that comes with the responsibility of providing for one's family. In the countless roles we take on as parents - caregiver, protector, educator, and provider - we become intimately acquainted with the challenges and triumphs of family life. We witness the struggles that many families face, whether it's making ends meet, securing access to quality education, or ensuring our children have the healthcare they need. It's in these moments that we are inspired to take action, to advocate for better opportunities, and to fight for a brighter future for our families. I know how to make our community, district, and America strong and proud because i’ve done it before. As your next Congresswoman for Maryland’s 6th Congressional District I will always fight for policies that will revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s out of control spending, champion school choice & parental rights, and save America’s future. But, in order to do this, I need your support today so I can spread this message to everyone across our district and country. Together we WILL flip Maryland’s 6th Congressional District for Republicans and make America strong and proud again. Sincerely, Mariela Roca | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | | | Copyright (C) 2023 Roca for Congress. All rights reserved.

Subject: Tell Congress: Demand a ceasefire now to save lives Peter, We remain heartbroken by the horrific events that have unfolded in Israel and Palestine since last weekend. Thousands of Israeli and Palestinian civilians have been killed, including children and the elderly, with thousands more injured. Hamas has targeted and killed Israeli civilians, taking over 150 hostages and refusing to release them. The Israeli government has cut 2 million Palestinian civilians off from food, water, fuel, and electricity in preparation for a full-scale ground invasion. **The scale of humanitarian catastrophe now facing Palestinians in Gaza is growing by the hour — and further escalation would endanger the lives of millions of Israeli and Palestinian families alike. President Biden and Congress must act now to demand a ceasefire to save lives.** [**The Working Families Party is proud to join Rep. Cori Bush, Rep. Rashida Tlaib, Rep. Summer Lee, Rep. Delia Ramirez, and more in support of a Congressional resolution calling for immediate de-escalation and ceasefire in Israel and occupied Palestine and to send humanitarian aid and assistance to Gaza. Will you take a minute to urge your member of Congress to call for ceasefire and de-escalation in order to save as many lives as possible?**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXdJUvH8Ygu3R43gD0WUPlZ5bxrMh6DpGopZ2QuEF3QSjxgFjnZkTlKuevgZGzwTncKET1nqgy_6Ew0y5LsY3EHxeTQztd4SPO8U6AohnhjdpEhjyFJQ777RhqSJ_PJKgQC2fa2ah-_CFVuDWuS9qqfUXsOuq2__qF7PxAj-Or3KPWygv19iisD8oVPM7vVFIk1Vx38gAQUqYuXETSC8ZQSWNKZiPZv6Od6h3_lBRNE5IsJ2sHedRVqTTsvGQFBzpjHURknCz4zgJ6DHi3FQA8t0HVrBpUDSHYK9Ca2ejh-lwZcqkkB-dPiSe7m7dfFhy-lgV0kChbPffKgLBvS9G_VM/40l/3KD6BU_tR16P_XhUmq6C1g/h2/RbzoDwgH8Zl_Y1R7F0EHIpRCKOFNBcVYDlwfUN02j9g) **[Take Action »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXdJUvH8Ygu3R43gD0WUPlZ5bxrMh6DpGopZ2QuEF3QSjxgFjnZkTlKuevgZGzwTncKET1nqgy_6Ew0y5LsY3EHxeTQztd4SPO8U6AohnhjdpEhjyFJQ777RhqSJ_PJKgQDLxZsIkJGunOkfwEceUvnOZix-_fYFPmJJPu5XEaPtnDEzbbmHgJMl23YUBw9EOFT6XM2IME6B7tvmCGZJSn_DXFuDPMFLahiYB28FUQjodV9I5rkWuPkg6P2EGnpCWaPHanB8-ilonVyuvHFo4gJX_cO774dimoIF5kjtD_xYCHs8jr3MJDBGQxt9gavlb0MTbI8KAGlIw5mbOq_VMiYY/40l/3KD6BU_tR16P_XhUmq6C1g/h3/_RERvoPuhSLrOa1dgCX9_qEwzEYAMa5Wm3PPWEr7QJY)** We believe that most people from all backgrounds across the world are appalled by Hamas's deliberate murder and abduction of Israeli civilians. Israel receives billions every year in U.S. military aid, and is likely to receive billions more to support its war on Hamas. The United States therefore bears responsibility for the conduct of Israel's war.

The Israeli military has cut off access to food, water, and electricity for civilians, in violation of international law. They’ve ordered millions to evacuate northern Gaza, an order that the United Nations immediately said would be “impossible” to accomplish “without devastating humanitarian consequences.”2 The Israeli President last week declared that “an entire nation” was responsible for Hamas’s attacks, words that seemingly aim to justify collective punishment in retribution.3 Meanwhile some elected leaders in the U.S. — including Republican members of Congress — have backed calls to “level” Gaza and “turn it into a parking lot.”4 We need to do all we can to stand up against this kind of rhetoric, and to stop further escalation from costing the lives of more children and families. clean_body: The calls for ceasefire and de-escalation in Israel and Palestine have been growing by the hour | | | Peter, Since we wrote you earlier this week, the calls for ceasefire and de-escalation in Israel and Palestine have been growing by the hour. More members of Congress are signing on in support of the resolution calling for a ceasefire every day, including Rep. Greg Casar (TX), Rep. Pramila Jayapal (WA), Rep. Barbara Lee (CA), Rep. Alma Adams (NC), and Rep. Maxwell Frost (FL). And a new poll out today shows that 66% of likely voters — including majorities of Democrats, Independents,and Republicans — want to see a ceasefire and de-escalation of violence in Gaza to prevent civilian deaths:1 We are proud to join courageous champions in Congress in support of a resolution calling for immediate de-escalation and ceasefire in Israel and occupied Palestine and to send humanitarian aid and assistance to Gaza. Or text CEASEFIRE to 30403 to be connected to your member of Congress' office via phone and urge them to support a ceasefire now. In solidarity, Team WFP \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Team WFP Date: Monday, October 16, 2023 Subject: Tell Congress: Demand a ceasefire now to save lives Peter, We remain heartbroken by the horrific events that have unfolded in Israel and Palestine since last weekend. Thousands of Israeli and Palestinian civilians have been killed, including children and the elderly, with thousands more injured. Hamas has targeted and killed Israeli civilians, taking over 150 hostages and refusing to release them. The Israeli government has cut 2 million Palestinian civilians off from food, water, fuel, and electricity in preparation for a full-scale ground invasion. The scale of humanitarian catastrophe now facing Palestinians in Gaza is growing by the hour — and further escalation would endanger the lives of millions of Israeli and Palestinian families alike. President Biden and Congress must act now to demand a ceasefire to save lives. We believe that most people from all backgrounds across the world are appalled by Hamas's deliberate murder and abduction of Israeli civilians. We believe that they are also appalled by the Israeli government's disregard for Palestinian civilian life in its military response and siege. And we believe that they recognize that the Palestinian people are not Hamas, and that the Israeli people are not the Israeli government. Israel receives billions every year in U.S. military aid, and is likely to receive billions more to support its war on Hamas. The United States therefore bears responsibility for the conduct of Israel's war. The Israeli military has cut off access to food, water, and electricity for civilians, in violation of international law. They’ve ordered millions to evacuate northern Gaza, an order that the United Nations immediately said would be “impossible” to accomplish “without devastating humanitarian consequences.”2 The Israeli President last week declared that “an entire nation” was responsible for Hamas’s attacks, words that seemingly aim to justify collective punishment in retribution.3 Meanwhile some elected leaders in the U.S. — including Republican members of Congress — have backed calls to “level” Gaza and “turn it into a parking lot.”4 We need to do all we can to stand up against this kind of rhetoric, and to stop further escalation from costing the lives of more children and families. In solidarity, Working Families Party P.S. You can read . **GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

name: Alex Padilla
subject: The Senate Mental Health Caucus
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alex Padilla for Senate
body:
In 2021, 1/3 of Americans with a serious mental illness did not receive any form of mental health care.
#

Hey there,
Mental health is an issue that touches the lives of every American –[including my own family](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/3240?t=1&akid=1571%2E159979%2EbuaRWb). Millions of people are struggling with their mental health, but are either unable to access or afford care, or are afraid of the stigma that seeking mental health care brings.
That’s why earlier this week I launched the Bipartisan Mental Health Caucus in the U.S. Senate, alongside my colleagues Thom Tillis, Tina Smith, and Joni Ernst.
There’s been a lot of good work done in Congress to address America’s mental health crisis, like the 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline, or the community-based mental health services in the _Bipartisan Safer Communities Act._
**But folks, there’s still a lot of work to do to make sure every American is able to live a happy, healthy life.**
In 2021, 1 out of 3 of Americans with a serious mental illness did not receive any form of mental health care.
That’s partially because there’s a nationwide shortage of trained mental health professionals, and even when treatment is available, it’s too often prohibitively expensive or inconvenient.
And it’s also partially because people are afraid of getting stigmatized or looked at differently because of their mental health struggles.
Together, we can address the mental health crisis facing our nation, and improve the quality of life for all Americans.
But it’s only going to happen if we break down the stigma around mental health, and make sure that all Americans are able to get the support they need. Thanks for reading, and for supporting this important work.
Alex Padilla

name: Ro Khanna
subject: Stronger unions benefit all of us
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ro for Congress
body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

The American labor movement is experiencing a renaissance and that’s good for workers, good for the economy, and good for business. The median net worth of working-class union households is almost 4 times that of non-union households.

I was one of the first members of Congress to join the Writers Guild of America on the picket line and I stood with them for over 100 days until they won wage increases and protections against AI outsourcing. I stood with healthcare workers at Kaiser Permanente who just reached a tentative agreement [https://apnews.com/article/kaiser-permanente-health-care-workers-strike-411aa1f084c19725f29ff87766e99704] for living wages and safe patient standards.

And I’ve been on the line with autoworkers, actors, and Starbucks baristas who are still fighting for the pay raises and improved working conditions they deserve.

These hardworking people represent the heart and soul of the American economy, making incredible strides for their industries. But we need to go further and make it easier for all workers to organize, form unions, ensure that corporations allow free and fair union elections, and demand that union workers are not retaliated against by Big Business.

Sign if you agree: We must strengthen workers’ right to organize. [https://actionnetwork.org/forms/sign-the-petition-unions-help-rebuild-the-middle-class-pass-the-pro-act-2?source=2023PRO_RK&referrer=group-ro-khanna&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fdk-pro-act-petition-swap]

Sign the Petition [https://actionnetwork.org/forms/sign-the-petition-unions-help-rebuild-the-middle-class-pass-the-pro-act-2?source=2023PRO_RK&referrer=group-ro-khanna&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fdk-pro-act-petition-swap]

The Protecting the Right to Organize (PRO) Act is a landmark bill designed to strengthen collective bargaining rights and hold corporations accountable for violating workers' rights. It would clear hurdles for workers to form and join unions, prevent employers from interfering in union elections, enhance protections for workers wrongfully terminated for union activities, and increase accountability for unfair labor practices.

Strong unions mean a strong middle class and a stronger economy overall. They mean fair wages, improved benefits, and better working conditions for everyone. That’s why the fight to unionize matters so much, and why we need to protect and support these unionization efforts.

Sign the petition: Tell Congress to pass the PRO Act. [https://actionnetwork.org/forms/sign-the-petition-unions-help-rebuild-the-middle-class-pass-the-pro-act-2?source=2023PRO_RK&referrer=group-ro-khanna&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fdk-pro-act-petition-swap]

In solidarity,
Ro

body:
Another day, another failed Speaker vote.

If it wasn’t clear before, it certainly is today: this Republican House majority is dysfunctional and cannot be trusted with the responsibility to lead or govern.

For more than two weeks now, the House has been rudderless and in disarray. We are crippled by a majority without the interest, will, or maturity to fulfill even their most basic responsibilities. When our constituents voted for us and elected us last November, they put their faith and trust in us to work for them every day — even when it gets hard or frustrating — to alleviate suffering and continue pushing for that more perfect union.

But at a time of unprecedented challenges around the world and across our own country, House Republicans are consumed with in-fighting and threats to gain power. We have to be better. We have no choice. So we must get to work to make change happen. All of us.

I am committed to doing everything I can — including raising the funds we desperately need to flip as many as 7 Republican-held seats here in California. We don't have to match Republicans dollar-for-dollar, but we have to raise enough to get out our message and mobilize our voters. Can you help with a contribution to flip these districts? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lvf_october_2023?amount=10]

Whatever you can do will go a long way to support this effort — and to get our House in order and back to work.

Zoe
Congresswoman Zoe Lofgren is a strong fighter for California’s values in Washington. As the Chair of the California Democratic Congressional Delegation, she has been on the front lines of expanding and protecting the Democratic Majority. But this chaos has only strengthened my commitment to defend the Philadelphia suburbs and win back the House majority for Democrats. We’re just 12 months out from Election Day 2024, and we’ll need a strong grassroots team standing with us every step of the way. Can I count on your support?

My team set a goal this week to activate 100 donors, and we’re just a few short! If you’re able, I hope you might consider chipping in $24 – or any amount – to help us prepare for the campaign ahead.

Peter,

After the Israeli army called for the immediate displacement of 1.1
million Palestinians while bragging about dropping 6,000 bombs on Gaza
within the span of a week, our Justice Democrats incumbent Rep. Cori Bush
stepped up and took action.

She introduced the Ceasefire Now Resolution in Congress, calling for
urgent de-escalation and a ceasefire between Israel and Gaza while
demanding humanitarian aid be delivered to the 2.2 million Palestinians
facing unimaginable violence paired with lack of access to electricity,
food, and water.

It may be unpopular with her out-of-touch colleagues, but Cori is speaking
truth to power and calling this conflict what it is: genocide and ethnic
cleansing of the Palestinian people.

It takes a huge amount of political courage to do what Cori did. While we
know she is standing on the right side of history, Cori is currently
facing political attacks from opponents on both sides of the aisle like
never before ahead of her 2024 re-election race.

civilians — mostly women and children — and the response from mainstream

If we are ever going to end the cycle of violence and forever wars and if
we want a safe return of hostages, we desperately need more
representatives like Cori in office to challenge the status quo.

Thank you for being with us during this difficult time, and remember to

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Since her first day on the campaign trail, Alexandria has been demanding that the rich pay their fair share.
Last month, the IRS announced an effort to shift their focus away from working-class taxpayers and towards 1,600 millionaires and 75 hedge funds with past due taxes.
Today, the IRS reported back that they’ve closed 100 of the cases they opened — **and collected $122 million in unpaid taxes. Just last month.**
Looks like taxing the rich actually works 🤷🏽♀️
[While members of both parties are invested in protecting tax breaks for yacht owners and people with private jets, Alexandria is determined to fight for economic justice for all of us. Will you chip in $5 today to power her fight?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231020.MBtq2X&refcode=em20231020-5188-P_FND_EGR_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5188%2E2526796%2EkXQLys)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231020.MBtq2X&refcode=em20231020-5188-P_FND_EGR_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5188%2E2526796%2EkXQLys)**
Recent estimates show that the top 1% gained $6.5 trillion in wealth in 2021, but failed to pay more than $163 billion in taxes that same year1 — making them the most significant tax evaders in the country.
Yet **House Republicans made it their top legislative priority this year to claw back 25% of funding allocated to the IRS by Democrats in the Inflation Reduction Act.**
Republicans then demanded tax breaks for the ultra-rich, while making cuts to SNAP to take food out of babies’ mouths — instead of re-examining the Trump tax cuts that added millions to our national debt.
[Why should single moms and veterans have to pay for the GOP’s giveaways to the rich? It’s time for the top 1% and corporations to pay their fair share. Can you contribute $5 today to keep Alexandria in Congress fighting for economic justice for all of us?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231020.MBtq2X&refcode=em20231020-5188-P_FND_EGR_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=5188%2E2526796%2EkXQLys)

In solidarity,
Team AOC

subject: Your Signature is Needed: Single-use plastic is destroying our oceans and planet
body:
| | | | | [](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2063851?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---|---|---

| | **URGENT PLASTIC PETITION: Demand an end to single-use plastic production and save baby sea turtles from CHOKING on plastic.[Act Now! ](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2063852?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)[>>](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2063852?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** This October, hundreds of baby sea turtles are emerging from their tiny shells to embark on their journey to the glistening ocean shore. _It’s an incredible sight to see, Friend!_ Their little flippers push through mounds of sand, hungry and eager to make it to their new home. Some hatchlings are too hungry to wait and venture off to search for food on the way. A curious baby sea turtle comes across a translucent object that looks like a delicious meal, and it begin to devour...but it discovers the object is hard to chew. What it doesn’t know is that the “snack” is actually _**PLASTIC WASTE.**_ In its haste to swallow, the plastic gets LODGED in the baby sea turtle’s tiny throat, and it begins to _**CHOKE!**_ **The precious hatchling will soon die of suffocation.** Friend, our beach shores and oceans are being invaded by single-use plastic waste, killing our beloved sea animals. **Ingesting just ONE single piece of plastic has a _20% chance_ of killing a sea turtle.** Single-use plastic production and pollution is decimating our oceans and wildlife. **[We need immediate action and solutions to combat the plastic crisis to save these innocent sea creatures. Will you join the fight? Sign the petition now>>](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2063853?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2063854?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Plastic consumption is up _**4 TIMES**_ what it was 30 years ago, with **36%** of plastic produced for packaging, including single-use water bottles, containers, and bags. Plastic is nonbiodegradable which means the plastic that was discarded in our communities and oceans many years ago will _**NEVER DISAPPEAR.**_ In fact, **less than 6%** of plastics are recycled annually in the United States. Of the rest, some are burned, and the vast majority go to landfills or escape into the environment -- contaminating our water sources, food supply, and even the air we breathe.
While beach cleanups and single-use plastic bans are crucial, _stopping the creation of more single-use plastics by halting the expansion of new petrochemical plants will address plastic pollution at the source._ We must _divest_ from petrochemicals and _invest_ in safe alternatives to preserve human health and allow our shared climate and oceans to thrive. We can no longer tolerate Big Plastic and Big Oil’s construction of dirty, massive plastic factories that **disproportionately spew toxic pollutants into nearby communities of color,** increasing the risk of serious health conditions for nearby residents.
**Single-use plastics have no home on our planet once they are used, and they threaten the future of people, wildlife, and the planet.** [**That’s why we’re calling on environmentalists like YOU to speak up before our 11:59pm deadline TONIGHT. Please, Friend, take action against single-use plastic production and pollution now before it’s too late!**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2063855?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
[SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2063854?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

Friends of the Earth**

Important.

Hi Peter,
Today I’ve got a major campaign update: We just got the first peek into my opponent’s fundraising report and there’s a lot to digest. I’m going to break it all down and ask you to donate $25 to help us fight back using this link: [_**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/JHCA-09-Email-Oct2023-FR-October**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71912220/433696311/1094747814?&refcode=E4630-20231020-PersonalEmail-SL-CampaignNews&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTYwZjMxMTEtOTU2Zi1lZTExLWIwMDQtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=TFVCgUSHSG_TAU5NG1RDokp3FFYMJx1qUkCCDtBa6Mk=)
First, I want to say thank you to every single person who has sent in a donation to my campaign. We sent in a report with over 2,000 individual contributions! That’s the power of your grassroots support. No corporate PACs, just people.
**But unfortunately the good news ends there. My opponent Kevin Lincoln raised more than any Republican I’ve ever faced while in office - and he was the #2 GOP raiser in the country! **
It’s a bit scary to be honest. We knew he was a top opponent, and now he’s proving it.
But I’m all about controlling the controllables. I can’t control if my opponent has a massive warchest, but I sure as heck can control how we respond to it. I’ve faced many tough elections in the past, and this one is clearly going to be no different. We will win by standing together.
So if you could please send in a donation of $25 or more today, it would go a long way towards helping us keep this seat blue. name: Gavin Newsom
subject: Something happened last night
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CAMPAIGN FOR DEMOCRACY PAC
body:
A right-wing federal judge overturned California's assault weapons ban.

Friends -
In just a moment, I am going to ask you to make a contribution to my Campaign for Democracy PAC. Please give me a chance to explain why this request — especially today — is so important.
Something important happened last night.
A right-wing federal judge overturned California's assault weapons ban. In his ruling — as he has done before — he compared an assault weapon to a knife.
It's an absolute disgrace.
Now let me make two things explicitly clear here:
1. California has some of the strongest gun laws in the country, and as a result, we have some of the lowest per-capita gun death rates in the country. What we have done here works.

2. Unless we pass a Constitutional Amendment to make our communities safer from gun violence, no gun laws are safe. Not laws passed in California — not laws passed in Congress.

We took the first step to do just that in California. Our legislature passed a resolution calling for a Constitutional amendment on guns.
One down.
More to go.
So here is what I am asking: we are starting to ramp up our efforts to introduce and pass more of these resolutions in more and more states. That means hiring lobbyists (yes). It means ads. It means on-the-ground organizing.
All of that takes money. But my pledge to you is we will put every dollar we raise from this team to work getting it done. It's that important.
[**Can I count on you to contribute $3 to my Campaign for Democracy PAC today? We will put every dollar we raise today directly to work introducing and passing resolutions calling for a Constitutional Amendment in more states across the country.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cfd-c-em-oct23/?refcode=em231020-1-f&refcode2=1622_4767699_qldwvY&akid=1622%2E4767699%2EqldwvY)
